```ts
/** Built once: a formatter is not free to construct, and a library page formats one per card each minute. */
const RELATIVE = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat('en', { numeric: 'always' });

/**
 * How long ago `at` was, seen from `now` (both epoch milliseconds), in the words a card or a status line says it:
 * "just now", "5 minutes ago", "3 days ago", "2 months ago".
 *
 * Shared rather than written into the library page, because the sheet's save status says the same thing ("Saved · just
 * now", design decision 9) and the two should never disagree about what "just now" means.
 *
 * - **Under a minute is "just now"**, and so is a time ahead of `now`: another tab's clock, or this one corrected since
 *   the write. The thing has happened; "in 3 minutes" would be nonsense.
 * - **Elapsed time, rounded down, never the calendar.** `numeric: 'always'` keeps `Intl` from saying "yesterday" or
 *   "last week", which are calendar claims: 30 hours before one in the morning was the day before yesterday. "1 day
 *   ago" is true either way.
 * - **Weeks under a month, months under a year.** A month is counted as 30 days and a year as 365: the card is a
 *   reminder of roughly when, and the exact moment is on its tooltip.
 * - **English**, as every other word on the page is; the browser's locale would put one translated phrase in an
 *   English sentence.
 */
export function relativeTimeOf(at: number, now: number): string {
  const seconds = Math.floor((now - at) / 1000);
  if (seconds < 60) return 'just now';

  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return RELATIVE.format(-minutes, 'minute');
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return RELATIVE.format(-hours, 'hour');
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  if (days < 7) return RELATIVE.format(-days, 'day');
  if (days < 30) return RELATIVE.format(-Math.floor(days / 7), 'week');
  if (days < 365) return RELATIVE.format(-Math.floor(days / 30), 'month');
  return RELATIVE.format(-Math.floor(days / 365), 'year');
}
```

```ts
/**
 * A key's name, as the progression page's rail writes it: the tonic, then the scale as the app's catalogue names it -
 * `C Ionian (Major)`, `A Aeolian (Natural Minor)`, `F# Dorian`. The library's cards print it.
 *
 * **That page's words and not "C major"**, though the design sketches the latter, because a song's key is any scale
 * that builds chords - Dorian, Harmonic Minor, Phrygian Dominant - and "major"/"minor" names two of them. The catalogue
 * names them all, and the sheet's own key control lists its scales under the same names, so a card says what the
 * sheet's control will show. The tonic is spelled by the key's own `preferSharps` (`tonicSpelling`), in ASCII as chord
 * names are - letter for letter what `MusicTheoryService.spellNote` gives the progression page.
 *
 * `scale` is the key's scale looked up by the caller (`ProgressionKeyContext.findScale`), or null for an id the app
 * does not know - a song saved before a scale was renamed - which leaves the tonic on its own, as the progression page
 * does, rather than printing `C undefined`.
 */
export function keyNameOf(key: ProgressionKey, scale: Pick<Scale, 'name'> | null): string {
  const tonic = formatNote(tonicSpelling(key));
  return scale === null ? tonic : `${tonic} ${scale.name}`;
}
```

```ts
import { Node } from 'prosemirror-model';
import { createExtensions } from '../../../models/progression-normalize';
import { ChordDegree, ProgressionKey } from '../../../models/progression.model';
import { SongDoc } from '../../../models/song.model';
import { deletedDatabase } from '../../../services/indexed-db.spec-helper';
import { AutosaveClock } from '../../../services/song-autosave';
import { chordSlotOf, sectionsOf, songMetaOf } from '../../../services/song-document';
import { SONG_LIBRARY_DB, SongLibraryService } from '../../../services/song-library.service';
import { songSchema } from '../../../services/song-schema';
import { SONG_PREFERENCES_STORAGE } from '../../../services/song-sheet-preferences.service';
import { SONG_AUTOSAVE_CLOCK, SongEditorComponent } from './song-editor.component';

const C_MAJOR: ProgressionKey = { tonic: 0, scaleId: 'ionian', preferSharps: true };
const IONIAN = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
const FOUR_FOUR = { numerator: 4, denominator: 4, isCommon: true };

function degreeAt(degree: number): ChordDegree {
  return {
    degree,
    alter: 0,
    extent: 3,
    quality: null,
    inversion: 0,
    suspension: 'none',
    extensions: createExtensions(),
    octave: 0
  };
}

function chord(degree: number): Node {
  return songSchema.node('chord', chordSlotOf(degreeAt(degree), C_MAJOR, IONIAN, FOUR_FOUR));
}

/** "Last Dance" in C major: one verse, C over "Got" and Am over "thinking". */
function lastDance(): Node {
  return songSchema.node(
    'doc',
    { title: 'Last Dance', artist: 'The Band', key: C_MAJOR, tempo: 100, timeSignature: FOUR_FOUR },
    [
      songSchema.node('section', { id: crypto.randomUUID(), label: 'Verse 1', kind: 'verse' }, [
        songSchema.node('lyricLine', null, [
          chord(0),
          songSchema.text('Got me '),
          chord(5),
          songSchema.text('thinking')
        ])
      ])
    ]
  );
}

/** Time moved by hand, starting now so "Saved · just now" reads as it would. */
class FakeClock implements AutosaveClock {
  time = Date.now();
  private timers: { handle: number; at: number; callback: () => void }[] = [];
  private nextHandle = 1;

  now(): number {
    return this.time;
  }

  setTimeout(callback: () => void, ms: number): unknown {
    const handle = this.nextHandle++;
    this.timers.push({ handle, at: this.time + ms, callback });
    return handle;
  }

  clearTimeout(handle: unknown): void {
    this.timers = this.timers.filter(timer => timer.handle !== handle);
  }

  tick(ms: number): void {
    const until = this.time + ms;
    for (;;) {
      const due = this.timers.filter(timer => timer.at <= until).sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at)[0];
      if (due === undefined) break;
      this.timers = this.timers.filter(timer => timer !== due);
      this.time = due.at;
      due.callback();
    }
    this.time = until;
  }
}

/** A promise the spec settles. */
class Deferred<T> {
  resolve: (value: T) => void = () => undefined;
  reject: (error: unknown) => void = () => undefined;
  readonly promise = new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    this.resolve = resolve;
    this.reject = reject;
  });
}

  const status = (): string => text('.save-status');
  const messages = (): string => text('.editor-messages');
  const names = (): string[] =>
    Array.from(host().querySelectorAll('.song-chord-name')).map(name => name.textContent ?? '');

  function element<T extends HTMLElement>(selector: string): T {
    const found = host().querySelector<T>(selector);
    if (!found) throw new Error(`No ${selector} on the page`);
    return found;
  }

  /** Resolves once `done` holds, checking every few milliseconds for up to two seconds: IndexedDB answers outside the zone. */
  async function until(done: () => boolean): Promise<void> {
    for (let waited = 0; waited < 2000; waited += 10) {
      harness.detectChanges();
      if (done()) return;
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
    }
    harness.detectChanges();
  }

  /** Stores "Last Dance" and returns its record. */
  async function storeSong(): Promise<SongDoc> {
    const created = await library.createSong();
    return library.saveSong({ ...created, content: lastDance().toJSON() });
  }

  /** Opens the song `id` and waits for its sheet. */
  async function open(id: string): Promise<SongEditorComponent> {
    const editor = await harness.navigateByUrl(`/songs/${id}`, SongEditorComponent);
    await until(() => host().querySelector('.ProseMirror') !== null);
    return editor;
  }

  /** The song as the library now holds it. */
  async function stored(id: string): Promise<Node> {
    const loaded = await library.loadSong(id);
    if (loaded?.kind !== 'song') throw new Error('The song did not load');
    return loaded.node;
  }

  function setTitle(title: string): void {
    const input = element<HTMLInputElement>('.song-title');
    input.value = title;
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
    harness.detectChanges();
  }

  function choose(selector: string, value: string): void {
    const select = element<HTMLSelectElement>(selector);
    select.value = value;
    select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
    harness.detectChanges();
  }

  function press(selector: string): void {
    element<HTMLButtonElement>(selector).click();
    harness.detectChanges();
  }

  describe('loading', () => {
    it('opens a song: its title, artist, chords and when it was saved', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);

      expect(element<HTMLInputElement>('.song-title').value).toBe('Last Dance');
      expect(element<HTMLInputElement>('.song-artist').value).toBe('The Band');
      expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'Am']);
      expect(status()).toBe('Saved · just now');
      expect(element<HTMLAnchorElement>('.back-to-library').getAttribute('href')).toBe('/songs');
    });

    it('says a song that is not there is no longer in the library, with the way back', async () => {
      await library.refresh();
      await harness.navigateByUrl('/songs/no-such-song', SongEditorComponent);
      await until(() => text('.song-missing') !== '');

      expect(text('.song-missing')).toContain('That song is no longer in the library');
      expect(host().querySelector('.song-missing a')?.getAttribute('href')).toBe('/songs');
      expect(host().querySelector('.ProseMirror')).toBeNull();
    });

    it('shows why a song cannot be opened, and never an editable sheet', async () => {
      await library.refresh();
      await putRaw({ id: 'broken', revision: 1, createdAt: 1, updatedAt: 1, content: { type: 'doc', content: [] } });
      await harness.navigateByUrl('/songs/broken', SongEditorComponent);
      await until(() => text('.song-unreadable') !== '');

      expect(text('.song-unreadable')).toContain('This song cannot be opened:');
      expect(host().querySelector('.song-unreadable a')?.getAttribute('href')).toBe('/songs');
      expect(host().querySelector('.ProseMirror')).toBeNull();
      expect(host().querySelector('.song-title')).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe('the header', () => {
    it('puts a title edit in the undo history', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);

      setTitle('First Dance');
      expect(status()).toBe('Unsaved changes');
      expect(element<HTMLButtonElement>('.undo').getAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe('false');

      press('.undo');
      expect(element<HTMLInputElement>('.song-title').value).toBe('Last Dance');
      press('.redo');
      expect(element<HTMLInputElement>('.song-title').value).toBe('First Dance');
    });

    it('edits the artist through the same history', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);

      const input = element<HTMLInputElement>('.song-artist');
      input.value = 'Someone Else';
      input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
      harness.detectChanges();
      press('.undo');
      expect(element<HTMLInputElement>('.song-artist').value).toBe('The Band');
    });

    it('says how the save is going, from unsaved to saving to saved', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);
      const write = new Deferred<SongDoc>();
      const save = spyOn(library, 'saveSong').and.returnValue(write.promise);

      setTitle('First Dance');
      expect(status()).toBe('Unsaved changes');

      clock.tick(800);
      harness.detectChanges();
      expect(status()).toBe('Saving…');
      expect(save).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(songMetaOf(Node.fromJSON(songSchema, save.calls.mostRecent().args[0].content)).title).toBe('First Dance');

      write.resolve({ ...song, revision: song.revision + 1, updatedAt: clock.now() });
      await until(() => status() === 'Saved · just now');
      expect(status()).toBe('Saved · just now');

      // Re-worded once a minute, counted from when the page opened, so six minutes on it has said "5 minutes ago".
      clock.tick(6 * 60_000);
      harness.detectChanges();
      expect(status()).toBe('Saved · 5 minutes ago');
    });

    it('carries each save’s record into the next, so the second save is not refused', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);

      setTitle('First Dance');
      clock.tick(800);
      await until(() => status() === 'Saved · just now');
      setTitle('Second Dance');
      clock.tick(800);
      await until(() => status() === 'Saved · just now');

      expect(songMetaOf(await stored(song.id)).title).toBe('Second Dance');
    });

    it('shows a failed save with its reason, and Retry saves again', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);
      const realSave = library.saveSong.bind(library);
      let calls = 0;
      spyOn(library, 'saveSong').and.callFake(doc => {
        calls++;
        return calls === 1 ? Promise.reject(new Error('The disk is full')) : realSave(doc);
      });

      setTitle('First Dance');
      clock.tick(800);
      await until(() => status().startsWith('Not saved'));
      expect(text('.save-status span')).toBe('Not saved: The disk is full');
      expect(host().querySelector('.retry-save')).not.toBeNull();
      expect(messages()).toBe('Not saved: The disk is full');

      press('.retry-save');
      await until(() => status() === 'Saved · just now');
      expect(status()).toBe('Saved · just now');
      expect(songMetaOf(await stored(song.id)).title).toBe('First Dance');
    });
  });

  describe('the toolbar', () => {
    it('re-spells the chords on the sheet when the key changes or the song is transposed', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);

      choose('.key-tonic', '7');
      expect(names()).toEqual(['G', 'Em']);

      press('.transpose-up');
      expect(names()).toEqual(['Ab', 'Fm']);
      expect(element<HTMLSelectElement>('.key-tonic').value).toBe('8b');

      choose('.key-scale', 'dorian');
      expect(songMetaOf(await saveNow(song.id)).key.scaleId).toBe('dorian');
    });

    it('offers only scales that can build chords', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);
      const offered = Array.from(element<HTMLSelectElement>('.key-scale').options).map(option => option.value);
      expect(offered).toContain('ionian');
      expect(offered).toContain('harmonicMinor');
      expect(offered).not.toContain('majorPentatonic');
      expect(offered).not.toContain('minorBlues');
      // A note filter for the fretboard, not a key, though its seven notes would stack.
      expect(offered).not.toContain('naturalNotes');
    });

    it('shows numerals in place of names, and says so on its button', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);

      press('.numerals-toggle');
      expect(names()).toEqual(['I', 'vi']);
      expect(element('.numerals-toggle').getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('true');
      press('.numerals-toggle');
      expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'Am']);
    });

    it('steps the lyric size through three sizes', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);
      const size = (): string | null => element('.song-sheet').getAttribute('data-lyric-size');

      expect(size()).toBe('medium');
      press('.lyric-size');
      expect(size()).toBe('large');
      press('.lyric-size');
      expect(size()).toBe('small');
      press('.lyric-size');
      expect(size()).toBe('medium');
    });

    it('holds the tempo to the range the song can play, and says so', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);

      const input = element<HTMLInputElement>('.song-tempo');
      input.value = '999';
      input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
      harness.detectChanges();

      expect(input.value).toBe('300');
      expect(messages()).toContain('300');
      expect(songMetaOf(await saveNow(song.id)).tempo).toBe(300);
    });

    it('sets the time signature from its two numbers', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);

      choose('.meter-numerator', '6');
      choose('.meter-denominator', '8');
      expect(songMetaOf(await saveNow(song.id)).timeSignature).toEqual({ numerator: 6, denominator: 8, isCommon: false });
    });

    it('adds a section of the kind chosen after the one with the caret', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);

      press('.add-section-toggle');
      press('.add-section [data-kind="verse"]');
      press('.add-section-toggle');
      press('.add-section [data-kind="chorus"]');
      // Ready for the new section's first words.
      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(element('.ProseMirror'));
      expect(sectionsOf(await saveNow(song.id)).map(section => section.label)).toEqual(['Verse 1', 'Verse 2', 'Chorus']);
    });
  });

  describe('saving', () => {
    it('saves what is pending when the page is left', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);

      setTitle('Left Behind');
      await harness.navigateByUrl('/songs');
      expect(host().querySelector('.library-stand-in')).not.toBeNull();

      // Nothing waited out the autosave delay: only the page's destroy can have saved it.
      let title = '';
      for (let waited = 0; waited < 2000 && title !== 'Left Behind'; waited += 10) {
        title = songMetaOf(await stored(song.id)).title;
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
      }
      expect(title).toBe('Left Behind');
    });

    it('saves at once when the page is hidden', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);
      const save = spyOn(library, 'saveSong').and.callThrough();

      setTitle('Hidden');
      spyOnProperty(Document.prototype, 'visibilityState', 'get').and.returnValue('hidden');
      document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange'));
      expect(save).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it('saves at once on pagehide', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      await open(song.id);
      const save = spyOn(library, 'saveSong').and.callThrough();

      setTitle('Gone');
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('pagehide'));
      expect(save).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it('asks before the tab closes only while something is unsaved', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();
      const editor = await open(song.id);
      // Handed to the listener rather than dispatched on `window`, where Karma takes any `beforeunload` for a reload.
      const unload = (): Event => {
        const event = new Event('beforeunload', { cancelable: true }) as BeforeUnloadEvent;
        editor.onBeforeUnload(event);
        return event;
      };

      expect(unload().defaultPrevented).toBeFalse();
      setTitle('Not yet');
      expect(unload().defaultPrevented).toBeTrue();
    });
  });

  it('puts a refused command’s reason in the page’s live region', async () => {
    const song = await storeSong();
    await open(song.id);

    press('.song-section-menu-toggle');
    const remove = Array.from(host().querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="menuitem"]')).find(
      item => item.textContent?.trim() === 'Delete'
    );
    remove?.click();
    harness.detectChanges();

    expect(messages()).toBe('A song keeps at least one section.');
    expect(host().querySelectorAll('.editor-messages [role="status"]').length).toBe(2);
  });

  /** Saves what is pending now, by the page's own route (pagehide), and returns the song as stored after. */
  async function saveNow(id: string): Promise<Node> {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('pagehide'));
    await until(() => status().startsWith('Saved'));
    return stored(id);
  }

  /** Writes `record` straight into the store, past the service: how a corrupt record gets there. */
  async function putRaw(record: unknown): Promise<void> {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const request = indexedDB.open(dbName, 1);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        const db = request.result;
        const transaction = db.transaction('songs', 'readwrite');
        transaction.objectStore('songs').put(record);
        transaction.oncomplete = () => {
          db.close();
          resolve();
        };
        transaction.onabort = () => {
          db.close();
          reject(transaction.error);
        };
      };
    });
  }
});
```

```ts
import { ComponentFixture, TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { Node } from 'prosemirror-model';
import { NodeSelection } from 'prosemirror-state';
import { createExtensions } from '../../../models/progression-normalize';
import { ChordDegree, ProgressionKey } from '../../../models/progression.model';
import { MusicTheoryService } from '../../../services/music-theory.service';
import { ProgressionKeyContext } from '../../../services/progression-key-context';
import { deleteSection, setTempo, transposeSong } from '../../../services/song-commands';
import { chordSlotOf, sectionsOf, songMetaOf } from '../../../services/song-document';
import { songSchema } from '../../../services/song-schema';
import { SongSheetComponent } from './song-sheet.component';

const C_MAJOR: ProgressionKey = { tonic: 0, scaleId: 'ionian', preferSharps: true };
const IONIAN = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
const FOUR_FOUR = { numerator: 4, denominator: 4, isCommon: true };

function degreeAt(degree: number, extent: 3 | 7 = 3): ChordDegree {
  return {
    degree,
    alter: 0,
    extent,
    quality: null,
    inversion: 0,
    suspension: 'none',
    extensions: createExtensions(),
    octave: 0
  };
}

/** A C major chord atom on `degree` (0-6): `chord(5)` is Am, `chord(6, 7)` is Bø7. */
function chord(degree: number, extent: 3 | 7 = 3): Node {
  return songSchema.node('chord', chordSlotOf(degreeAt(degree, extent), C_MAJOR, IONIAN, FOUR_FOUR));
}

function line(...content: (string | Node)[]): Node {
  return songSchema.node(
    'lyricLine',
    null,
    content.map(part => (typeof part === 'string' ? songSchema.text(part) : part))
  );
}

function section(id: string, label: string, ...lines: Node[]): Node {
  return songSchema.node('section', { id, label, kind: 'verse' }, lines.length > 0 ? lines : [line()]);
}

function song(...sections: Node[]): Node {
  return songSchema.node(
    'doc',
    { title: 'Last Dance', artist: '', key: C_MAJOR, tempo: 100, timeSignature: FOUR_FOUR },
    sections
  );
}

  function letterAfter(el: HTMLElement): DOMRect {

    if (!next) throw new Error('No letter after the chord');

      const disabled = items.filter(item => item.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true').map(item => item.textContent?.trim());
      expect(disabled).toEqual(['Move up']);
    });

    it('renames a section in place, taking the kind from a section word', () => {
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1')));
      choose(0, 'Rename');
      const field = host.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('.song-section-rename');
      if (!field) throw new Error('No rename field');
      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(field);
      expect(field.value).toBe('Verse 1');

      field.value = 'Chorus';
      field.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true }));
      const [renamed] = sectionsOf(current());
      expect(renamed.label).toBe('Chorus');
      expect(renamed.kind).toBe('chorus');
      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(toggles()[0]);
    });

    it('keeps the kind for a name that is not a section word, and Escape keeps the name', () => {
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1')));
      choose(0, 'Rename');
      const field = host.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('.song-section-rename');
      if (!field) throw new Error('No rename field');
      field.value = 'Hook';
      field.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true }));
      expect(sectionsOf(current())[0].label).toBe('Verse 1');

      choose(0, 'Rename');
      field.value = 'Hook';
      field.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true }));
      expect(sectionsOf(current())[0]).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({ label: 'Hook', kind: 'verse' }));
    });

    it('is reachable by keyboard: arrows walk the menu and Escape closes it on its button', () => {
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1'), section('c1', 'Chorus')));
      const toggle = toggles()[0];
      toggle.click();
      expect(toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
      const menu = host.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.song-section [role="menu"]');
      if (!menu) throw new Error('No menu');
      expect(document.activeElement?.textContent?.trim()).toBe('Rename');

      menu.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowDown', bubbles: true }));
      expect(document.activeElement?.textContent?.trim()).toBe('Move up');
      menu.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowUp', bubbles: true }));
      menu.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowUp', bubbles: true }));
      expect(document.activeElement?.textContent?.trim()).toBe('Delete');

      menu.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true }));
      expect(toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(toggle);
    });
  });

  describe('lyrics', () => {
    it('is a labelled, multi-line textbox in a monospace font', () => {
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1')));
      const editor = host.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ProseMirror');
      expect(editor?.getAttribute('role')).toBe('textbox');
      expect(editor?.getAttribute('aria-multiline')).toBe('true');
      expect(editor?.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBeTruthy();
      const line = host.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.song-lyric-line');
      if (!line) throw new Error('No line');
      expect(getComputedStyle(line).fontFamily).toMatch(/mono/i);
    });

    it('takes typing into the document and says so', async () => {
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1', line('Got me'))));
      sheet.focus();
      document.execCommand('insertText', false, 'Oh ');
      await settled();

      expect(current().textContent).toBe('Oh Got me');
      expect(changed.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(changed[changed.length - 1].textContent).toBe('Oh Got me');
    });

    it('shows the placeholder on the empty line holding the caret, and only there', () => {
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1', line(), line('words'), line())));
      const lines = (): HTMLElement[] => Array.from(host.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.song-lyric-line'));
      expect(lines().map(el => el.classList.contains('is-placeholder'))).toEqual([true, false, false]);
      expect(lines()[0].getAttribute('data-placeholder')).toBe('Lyrics…');
    });
  });

  describe('commands', () => {
    it('runs a song command on its view and reports the history', () => {
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1')));
      const history: { canUndo: boolean; canRedo: boolean }[] = [];
      sheet.historyChanged.subscribe(state => history.push(state));

      expect(sheet.run(setTempo(120))).toBeTrue();
      expect(songMetaOf(current()).tempo).toBe(120);
      expect(history[history.length - 1]).toEqual({ canUndo: true, canRedo: false });

      expect(sheet.undo()).toBeTrue();
      expect(songMetaOf(current()).tempo).toBe(100);
      expect(history[history.length - 1]).toEqual({ canUndo: false, canRedo: true });
      expect(sheet.redo()).toBeTrue();
      expect(songMetaOf(current()).tempo).toBe(120);
    });

    it('hands a refusal to its output and answers false', () => {
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1')));
      expect(sheet.run(deleteSection('v1'))).toBeFalse();
      expect(refusals).toEqual(['A song keeps at least one section.']);
    });
  });
});
```

`client/src/app/services/song-sheet-preferences.service.spec.ts`, new:

<!-- apply: create client/src/app/services/song-sheet-preferences.service.spec.ts -->
```ts
import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';
import {
  SONG_PREFERENCES_STORAGE,
  SongSheetPreferences,
  SongSheetPreferencesService
} from './song-sheet-preferences.service';

/** An in-memory `Storage`, so these specs never touch the developer's own `localStorage`. */
class MemoryStorage implements Storage {
  private readonly items = new Map<string, string>();
  get length(): number {
    return this.items.size;
  }
  clear(): void {
    this.items.clear();
  }
  getItem(key: string): string | null {
    return this.items.get(key) ?? null;
  }
  key(index: number): string | null {
    return [...this.items.keys()][index] ?? null;
  }
  removeItem(key: string): void {
    this.items.delete(key);
  }
  setItem(key: string, value: string): void {
    this.items.set(key, value);
  }
}

const KEY = 'songSheetPreferences';

/** How the sheet is shown to this viewer: names or numerals, and the lyric size - kept per browser, never in a song. */
describe('SongSheetPreferencesService', () => {
  let storage: MemoryStorage;

  function serviceWith(store: Storage | null): SongSheetPreferencesService {
    TestBed.configureTestingModule({ providers: [{ provide: SONG_PREFERENCES_STORAGE, useValue: store }] });
    return TestBed.inject(SongSheetPreferencesService);
  }

  beforeEach(() => {
    storage = new MemoryStorage();
  });

  it('starts on chord names at the medium size when nothing is stored', () => {
    expect(serviceWith(storage).preferences).toEqual({ numerals: false, lyricSize: 'medium' });
  });

  it('reads back what an earlier visit chose', () => {
    storage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify({ numerals: true, lyricSize: 'large' }));
    expect(serviceWith(storage).preferences).toEqual({ numerals: true, lyricSize: 'large' });
  });

  it('keeps each stored choice it can read and defaults the rest', () => {
    storage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify({ numerals: 'yes', lyricSize: 'small' }));
    expect(serviceWith(storage).preferences).toEqual({ numerals: false, lyricSize: 'small' });
  });

  it('defaults everything over a stored value that is not JSON', () => {
    storage.setItem(KEY, '{not json');
    expect(serviceWith(storage).preferences).toEqual({ numerals: false, lyricSize: 'medium' });
  });

  it('publishes and stores each change', async () => {
    const service = serviceWith(storage);
    service.setNumerals(true);
    service.setLyricSize('small');

    const published: SongSheetPreferences = await firstValueFrom(service.preferences$);
    expect(published).toEqual({ numerals: true, lyricSize: 'small' });
    expect(JSON.parse(storage.getItem(KEY) ?? 'null')).toEqual({ numerals: true, lyricSize: 'small' });
  });

  it('does not publish a choice that changes nothing', () => {
    const service = serviceWith(storage);
    const seen: SongSheetPreferences[] = [];
    service.preferences$.subscribe(preferences => seen.push(preferences));
    service.setNumerals(false);
    service.setLyricSize('medium');
    expect(seen.length).toBe(1);
  });

  it('works for the visit when the browser gives it no storage', () => {
    const service = serviceWith(null);
    service.setNumerals(true);
    expect(service.preferences.numerals).toBeTrue();
  });

  it('keeps a choice for the visit when the browser refuses to store it', () => {
    spyOn(storage, 'setItem').and.throwError(new DOMException('Full', 'QuotaExceededError'));
    const service = serviceWith(storage);
    service.setLyricSize('large');
    expect(service.preferences.lyricSize).toBe('large');
  });

  it('starts on the defaults when the browser refuses to read storage', () => {
    spyOn(storage, 'getItem').and.throwError(new DOMException('Denied', 'SecurityError'));
    expect(serviceWith(storage).preferences).toEqual({ numerals: false, lyricSize: 'medium' });
  });
});
```

```html
  <header class="editor-bar">
    <a class="back-to-library" routerLink="/songs">← Library</a>

    <ng-container *ngIf="phase === 'ready'">
      <div class="song-identity">
        <label class="identity-field">
          <span class="field-name">Title</span>
          <input
            #titleField
            type="text"
            class="song-title"
            placeholder="Untitled song"
            autocomplete="off"
            [value]="title"
            (change)="commitTitle(titleField.value)"
            (keydown.enter)="titleField.blur()"
            (keydown.escape)="revertField(titleField, title)"
          />
        </label>
        <label class="identity-field">
          <span class="field-name">Artist</span>
          <input
            #artistField
            type="text"
            class="song-artist"
            placeholder="Artist"
            autocomplete="off"
            [value]="artist"
            (change)="commitArtist(artistField.value)"
            (keydown.enter)="artistField.blur()"
            (keydown.escape)="revertField(artistField, artist)"
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      <!-- Not a live region: it changes on every pause in typing. A failure is also said in the region below. -->
      <p class="save-status" [class.is-error]="status?.kind === 'failed'">
        <span>{{ statusText }}</span>
        <button *ngIf="status?.kind === 'failed'" type="button" class="tool retry-save" (click)="retry()">Retry</button>
      </p>
    </ng-container>
  </header>

  <!--
    Everything the page says that is not on screen already. Always on the page and only its words change, in two halves
    that swap so a repeated message is a change (`SongEditorComponent.messages`). Polite: nothing here interrupts.
  -->
  <p class="editor-messages" [class.is-error]="messageIsError">
    <span role="status">{{ messages[0] }}</span><span role="status">{{ messages[1] }}</span>
  </p>

  <ng-container [ngSwitch]="phase">
    <!-- A status, so a screen reader hears that the page is waiting rather than meeting an empty page. -->
    <p *ngSwitchCase="'loading'" class="editor-state loading" role="status">Loading…</p>

    <div *ngSwitchCase="'missing'" class="editor-state song-missing">
      <p>That song is no longer in the library.</p>
      <a routerLink="/songs">Back to the library</a>
    </div>

    <div *ngSwitchCase="'unreadable'" class="editor-state song-unreadable">
      <p>This song cannot be opened: {{ reason }}</p>
      <a routerLink="/songs">Back to the library</a>
    </div>

    <ng-container *ngSwitchCase="'ready'">
      <app-song-toolbar
        [doc]="doc"
        [keys]="keys"
        [canUndo]="history.canUndo"
        [canRedo]="history.canRedo"
        (edit)="run($event)"
        (undo)="undo()"
        (redo)="redo()"
        (notice)="say($event)"
        (sheetFocus)="focusSheet()"
      ></app-song-toolbar>

      <!-- One column for now; the Chords panel (task 8) is a second column beside the sheet. -->
      <div class="editor-body">
        <div class="sheet-pane">
          <app-song-sheet
            [initialDoc]="initialDoc"
            [keys]="keys"
            [numerals]="preferences.numerals"
            [lyricSize]="preferences.lyricSize"
            (docChanged)="onDocChanged($event)"
            (historyChanged)="onHistoryChanged($event)"
            (refused)="say($event, true)"
            (notice)="say($event)"
          ></app-song-sheet>
        </div>
      </div>
    </ng-container>
  </ng-container>
</div>
```

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component } from '@angular/core';

/**
 * A song's sheet, at `/songs/:id` (design Part 2): the page the library's cards open.
 *
 * So far it is the page's frame alone - the way back to the library, and the line it shows while the song is read -
 * so the route, the library's links and the nav can be built and checked against the component that will hold the
 * editor, under the name and in the folder it keeps. The editor itself, its toolbar and its side panel grow in this
 * file.
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-song-editor',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  templateUrl: './song-editor.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./song-editor.component.scss']
})
export class SongEditorComponent {}
```

```ts
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  ChangeDetectorRef,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  HostListener,
  InjectionToken,
  NgZone,
  OnDestroy,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject
} from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { Node } from 'prosemirror-model';
import { Subject, from } from 'rxjs';
import { distinctUntilChanged, map, switchMap, takeUntil, tap } from 'rxjs/operators';
import type { SongDoc } from '../../../models/song.model';
import { messageOf } from '../../../services/error-message';
import { MusicTheoryService } from '../../../services/music-theory.service';
import { ProgressionKeyContext } from '../../../services/progression-key-context';
import { relativeTimeOf } from '../../../services/relative-time';
import { AutosaveClock, BROWSER_CLOCK, SaveStatus, SongAutosave } from '../../../services/song-autosave';
import { SongEdit, setArtist, setTitle } from '../../../services/song-commands';
import { songMetaOf } from '../../../services/song-document';
import { SongLibraryService } from '../../../services/song-library.service';
import { SongSheetPreferencesService } from '../../../services/song-sheet-preferences.service';
import { SheetHistory, SongSheetComponent } from '../song-sheet/song-sheet.component';
import { SongToolbarComponent } from '../song-toolbar/song-toolbar.component';

/**
 * The clock autosave and the "Saved · 5 minutes ago" wording run on. The browser's own unless a spec hands in one it
 * moves by hand: the page makes its `SongAutosave` itself, so this is the one seam through which its timing reaches
 * a spec.
 */
export const SONG_AUTOSAVE_CLOCK = new InjectionToken<AutosaveClock>('SONG_AUTOSAVE_CLOCK', {
  providedIn: 'root',
  factory: () => BROWSER_CLOCK
});

/** How often "Saved · 5 minutes ago" is worded again while the page is open. */
const REWORD_MS = 60_000;

/** What the page is showing. */
type Phase = 'loading' | 'ready' | 'missing' | 'unreadable';

/** What opening the route's song came to. */
type Opened =
  | { kind: 'song'; record: SongDoc; node: Node }
  | { kind: 'missing' }
  | { kind: 'unreadable'; reason: string };

/**
 * A song's page, `/songs/:id` (design Part 2): the header - back to the library, the title and artist, the save
 * status - the song's toolbar, and the sheet.
 *
 * **The song lives in the sheet.** Its document is the sheet's ProseMirror state; this page keeps the latest copy the
 * sheet published (`doc`) only to show it - the title fields, the toolbar - and to hand it to autosave. Every change
 * goes to the sheet as a command (`run`), so the title, the key and the tempo are in the same undo history as the
 * words.
 *
 * **Autosave**, as `SongAutosave`'s comment asks of its page: one per loaded song, persisting through
 * `SongLibraryService.saveSong` and carrying each saved record into the next save, so the revision compare-and-swap
 * sees its own last write; `change` on every new document; `flush` when the tab is hidden or the page is being
 * unloaded; `hasUnsavedChanges` to ask before a tab with unsaved work is closed; `destroy` - which saves what is
 * pending - when the page goes or another song is opened in it.
 *
 * **One polite live region** (`messages`) says everything the page has to say that is not on screen already: a
 * refused command and why, a section deleted and how to get it back, a tempo held to its range, a save that failed -
 * as the library page and the progression page do, two halves that swap so a repeat is still announced. The save
 * status line itself is not live: it changes on every pause in typing, and announcing "Saving…" each time would bury
 * everything else. A failure is the exception, and goes to the region too.
 *
 * The page is laid out as a one-column grid under the toolbar so the Chords panel (task 8) slots in as a second
 * column without moving the sheet.
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-song-editor',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, RouterLink, SongSheetComponent, SongToolbarComponent],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  templateUrl: './song-editor.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./song-editor.component.scss']
})
export class SongEditorComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly library = inject(SongLibraryService);
  private readonly preferencesService = inject(SongSheetPreferencesService);
  private readonly changes = inject(ChangeDetectorRef);
  private readonly zone = inject(NgZone);
  private readonly clock = inject(SONG_AUTOSAVE_CLOCK);
  private readonly destroy$ = new Subject<void>();
  /** Ends the subscriptions of the song open now, when another is opened in its place or the page goes. */
  private readonly songClosed$ = new Subject<void>();

  /** The app's key rules, handed to the toolbar for its commands and to the sheet for its chord names. */
  readonly keys = new ProgressionKeyContext(inject(MusicTheoryService));

  @ViewChild(SongSheetComponent) private sheet?: SongSheetComponent;
  @ViewChild('titleField') private titleField?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;
  @ViewChild('artistField') private artistField?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  phase: Phase = 'loading';
  /** Why the song cannot be opened, in the `unreadable` phase. */
  reason = '';
  /** The document the sheet starts from; set once per song opened. */
  initialDoc: Node | null = null;
  /** The latest document the sheet has published. */
  doc: Node | null = null;
  title = '';
  artist = '';
  status: SaveStatus | null = null;
  /** The save status in words: "Saved · just now", "Saving…", "Unsaved changes", "Not saved: <reason>". */
  statusText = '';
  history: SheetHistory = { canUndo: false, canRedo: false };
  preferences = this.preferencesService.preferences;

  /** The live region's two halves (see the class comment). */
  messages: readonly [string, string] = ['', ''];
  messageIsError = false;

  private autosave: SongAutosave<Node> | null = null;
  private rewordTimer: unknown = null;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.preferencesService.preferences$.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$)).subscribe(preferences => {
      this.preferences = preferences;
      this.changes.markForCheck();
    });

    // Another song opened in this page - a link from one song to another - reuses the page, so each id the route
    // gives is a close of the song before it and an open of the new one; a song still loading when the next id
    // arrives is dropped (`switchMap`).
    this.route.paramMap
      .pipe(
        map(params => params.get('id') ?? ''),
        distinctUntilChanged(),
        tap(() => this.closeSong()),
        switchMap(id => from(this.openedOf(id))),
        takeUntil(this.destroy$)
      )
      .subscribe(opened => this.zone.run(() => this.show(opened)));

    this.scheduleReword();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.closeSong();
    this.clock.clearTimeout(this.rewordTimer);
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // The page's events
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Hidden - another tab, the window minimised, the phone locked - is often the last the page hears: save now. */
  @HostListener('document:visibilitychange')
  onVisibilityChange(): void {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') this.saveNow();
  }

  /** Best effort: the browser may stop the page before an IndexedDB write commits, which is why hidden saves first. */
  @HostListener('window:pagehide')
  onPageHide(): void {
    this.saveNow();
  }

  /**
   * Asks before the tab closes or reloads while a change is not yet saved, and starts saving it. With nothing pending
   * the tab closes without a word.
   */
  @HostListener('window:beforeunload', ['$event'])
  onBeforeUnload(event: BeforeUnloadEvent): void {
    this.commitFields();
    if (!this.autosave?.hasUnsavedChanges()) return;
    void this.autosave.flush();
    event.preventDefault();
    // Older browsers ask only when `returnValue` is set; its text is never shown.
    event.returnValue = '';
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // What the template calls
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Runs a command on the sheet: the toolbar's, and the header's title and artist. */
  run(edit: SongEdit): void {
    this.sheet?.run(edit);
  }

  onDocChanged(doc: Node): void {
    this.adopt(doc);
    this.autosave?.change(doc);
  }

  onHistoryChanged(history: SheetHistory): void {
    this.history = history;
  }

  undo(): void {
    this.sheet?.undo();
  }

  redo(): void {
    this.sheet?.redo();
  }

  focusSheet(): void {
    this.sheet?.focus();
  }

  /**
   * The title committed - Enter, or leaving the field - as one command, so one undo step: the field is not a command
   * per keystroke, which would make every letter of a title an undo step of its own.
   */
  commitTitle(value: string): void {
    if (value !== this.title) this.run(setTitle(value));
  }

  commitArtist(value: string): void {
    if (value !== this.artist) this.run(setArtist(value));
  }

  /** Escape in the title or artist field puts back what the song says and leaves the field. */
  revertField(field: HTMLInputElement, value: string): void {
    field.value = value;
    field.blur();
  }

  /** Retry, after a failed save: saves now, with the change that failed or anything newer. */
  retry(): void {
    void this.autosave?.flush();
  }

  /** Puts `message` in the live region, in the half that is empty (see `messages`). */
  say(message: string, isError = false): void {
    this.messages = this.messages[0] === '' ? [message, ''] : ['', message];
    this.messageIsError = isError;
    this.changes.markForCheck();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Opening and closing a song
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** The song `id` read from the library, as what the page will show. Never rejects: a failed read is a reason. */
  private async openedOf(id: string): Promise<Opened> {
    try {
      const loaded = await this.library.loadSong(id);
      if (loaded === null) return { kind: 'missing' };
      if (loaded.kind === 'unreadable') return { kind: 'unreadable', reason: loaded.reason };
      return { kind: 'song', record: loaded.doc, node: loaded.node };
    } catch (error) {
      return { kind: 'unreadable', reason: messageOf(error) };
    }
  }

  private show(opened: Opened): void {
    if (opened.kind === 'missing') {
      this.phase = 'missing';
    } else if (opened.kind === 'unreadable') {
      this.phase = 'unreadable';
      this.reason = opened.reason;
    } else {
      this.startAutosave(opened.record);
      this.initialDoc = opened.node;
      this.adopt(opened.node);
      this.phase = 'ready';
    }
    this.changes.markForCheck();
  }

  /**
   * Makes the song's autosave. Its `persist` keeps the record each save returns and sends the next save from it: the
   * library refuses a save whose revision is not the stored one, and only the record it last wrote has that revision.
   * `SongAutosave` never runs two persists at once, so the record is never read while a save is still writing it.
   */
  private startAutosave(saved: SongDoc): void {
    let record = saved;
    const autosave = new SongAutosave<Node>({
      persist: async doc => {
        record = await this.library.saveSong({ ...record, content: doc.toJSON() });
      },
      savedAt: record.updatedAt,
      clock: this.clock
    });
    this.autosave = autosave;
    autosave.status$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.songClosed$))
      .subscribe(status => this.zone.run(() => this.onStatus(status)));
  }

  /**
   * Lets the open song go: whatever its fields hold is committed, its pending change saved (`destroy`, which goes on
   * after the page has gone, and lands), and the page emptied for the next.
   */
  private closeSong(): void {
    this.commitFields();
    this.songClosed$.next();
    const autosave = this.autosave;
    this.autosave = null;
    void autosave?.destroy();

    this.phase = 'loading';
    this.initialDoc = null;
    this.doc = null;
    this.status = null;
    this.statusText = '';
    this.history = { canUndo: false, canRedo: false };
  }

  private adopt(doc: Node): void {
    this.doc = doc;
    const meta = songMetaOf(doc);
    this.title = meta.title;
    this.artist = meta.artist;
    this.changes.markForCheck();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Saving
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Commits what the fields hold and saves everything pending now. */
  private saveNow(): void {
    this.commitFields();
    void this.autosave?.flush();
  }

  /**
   * Commits a title or artist still being typed. A field commits when it is left, and hiding the tab or closing it
   * does not leave it - the focus stays put - so without this the last words typed there would not be saved.
   */
  private commitFields(): void {
    const title = this.titleField?.nativeElement.value;
    const artist = this.artistField?.nativeElement.value;
    if (title !== undefined) this.commitTitle(title);
    if (artist !== undefined) this.commitArtist(artist);
  }

  private onStatus(status: SaveStatus): void {
    this.status = status;
    this.wordStatus();
    if (status.kind === 'failed') this.say(`Not saved: ${status.reason}`, true);
  }

  private wordStatus(): void {
    const status = this.status;
    switch (status?.kind) {
      case 'saved':
        this.statusText = `Saved · ${relativeTimeOf(status.at, this.clock.now())}`;
        break;
      case 'saving':
        this.statusText = 'Saving…';
        break;
      case 'unsaved':
        this.statusText = 'Unsaved changes';
        break;
      case 'failed':
        this.statusText = `Not saved: ${status.reason}`;
        break;
      default:
        this.statusText = '';
    }
    this.changes.markForCheck();
  }

  /**
   * Words the save status again each minute, so "just now" becomes "1 minute ago" on a page left open. On the
   * autosave's clock, so a spec moving time moves this too; outside Angular's zone, so a timer always pending never
   * keeps the zone from settling, and back in it only to re-word.
   */
  private scheduleReword(): void {
    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.rewordTimer = this.clock.setTimeout(() => {
        this.zone.run(() => this.wordStatus());
        this.scheduleReword();
      }, REWORD_MS);
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Node } from 'prosemirror-model';
import { NodeSelection, Plugin } from 'prosemirror-state';
import type { EditorView, NodeView } from 'prosemirror-view';
import type { ProgressionKey } from '../../../models/progression.model';
import type { ChordAtomAttrs } from '../../../models/song.model';
import { spokenChordName } from '../../../services/progression-chord-names';
import { effectiveChord } from '../../../services/progression-harmony';
import { chordRootName } from '../../../services/progression-spelling';
import { leadSheetNameOf, numeralOf } from '../../../services/song-chord-names';

/**
 * A chord atom on the sheet: its name over the letter it is anchored to, taking no width in the words (design
 * Part 2), and the measuring that keeps two names from colliding.
 *
 * ## How a name sits over its letter
 *
 * The atom is an empty inline `span` placed just before the letter, so it is zero wide and its left edge is that
 * letter's left edge. The name is absolutely positioned inside it, at its right edge and just above the text, so it
 * starts exactly where the letter starts and takes no room in the line. The line keeps room above itself for the
 * names (the sheet's SCSS), so a name never covers the line before it.
 *
 * ## When two names would collide
 *
 * Two chords a letter or two apart would print their names on top of one another. The line widens instead: the later
 * chord's span gets left padding, which pushes it - and the letter after it - right until its name clears the one
 * before it. The name stays at the span's right edge, so it is still over its own letter. The padding is measured, not
 * computed from character counts, because names are a proportional bold face over a monospace line and the lyric size
 * is the viewer's to change; `chordSpacingPlugin` measures after every update of the view.
 */

/** What a chord's name is worked out from: the song's key and its scale, and whether the sheet shows numerals. */
export interface ChordNaming {
  key: ProgressionKey;
  /** The key's scale when it can build chords, else null - and then no chord can be named. */
  scaleIntervals: readonly number[] | null;
  numerals: boolean;
}

/** What the sheet prints for a chord, and what it says to assistive technology. */
export interface ChordLabel {
  text: string;
  spoken: string;
}

/**
 * The room left between two names, as a share of the name's font size: about a narrow letter's width, enough to read
 * `C` `F` as two chords and not `CF`.
 */
const NAME_GAP_EM = 0.5;

/** What a chord with no name prints: one detached from its degree, or one in a key no chord can be named in. */
const UNLABELLED: ChordLabel = Object.freeze({ text: '?', spoken: 'chord, unlabelled' });

/** A note name as said aloud: `Bb` is "B flat", `F##` "F double sharp" - `spokenChordName`'s rule for its root. */
function spokenNoteOf(name: string): string {
  if (name.length < 2) return name;
  return `${name[0]} ${name.length > 2 ? 'double ' : ''}${name[1] === '#' ? 'sharp' : 'flat'}`;
}

/**
 * A chord's label: its lead-sheet name (`Am`, `Bb7`, `F/A`) or, with numerals on, its Roman numeral (`vi`, `♭VII`),
 * and in either case a spoken name for its `aria-label`, "chord A minor", "chord F major over A".
 *
 * **The spoken name is the chord's name even with numerals showing.** A numeral read aloud is a string of letters -
 * "vee eye" - and the name says which chord it is, which is what someone placing a word under it needs; the numeral is
 * a way of *showing* the chord, as the progression page's cards treat it.
 *
 * A literal chord - one detached from the key, which the sheet itself never makes but Open in Progression can bring
 * back (task 10) - has no degree to name, and is printed `?`, as `chordName` prints a chord it cannot name: unlabelled
 * rather than mislabelled.
 */
export function chordLabelOf(attrs: ChordAtomAttrs, naming: ChordNaming): ChordLabel {
  const { harmony } = attrs;
  const intervals = naming.scaleIntervals;
  if (harmony.kind !== 'degree' || intervals === null) return UNLABELLED;

  const degree = harmony.degree;
  const name = leadSheetNameOf(degree, naming.key, intervals);
  const root = chordRootName(naming.key, intervals, degree);
  // The bass is the text after the last slash - but only for an inversion: `C6/9` is a figure, not a slash chord.
  const bass = degree.inversion === 0 ? null : name.slice(name.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
  const spoken = `chord ${spokenChordName(root, effectiveChord(intervals, degree))}`;

  return {
    text: naming.numerals ? numeralOf(degree, intervals) : name,
    spoken: bass === null ? spoken : `${spoken} over ${spokenNoteOf(bass)}`
  };
}

/**
 * The chord atom's node view: an empty `span.song-chord` carrying the name in `span.song-chord-name`.
 *
 * Its name is asked of `naming` on every render rather than held, because what it depends on - the song's key and the
 * names/numerals toggle - lives outside the atom: ProseMirror calls `update` only when the atom itself changes, so
 * the sheet calls `render` on every live view (`views`) when the key or the toggle does.
 */
export class ChordView implements NodeView {
  readonly dom: HTMLElement;
  private readonly name: HTMLElement;

  constructor(
    private node: Node,
    private readonly view: EditorView,
    private readonly getPos: () => number | undefined,
    private readonly naming: () => ChordNaming,
    private readonly views: Set<ChordView>
  ) {
    this.dom = document.createElement('span');
    this.dom.className = 'song-chord';
    // An image of a chord symbol, named by its label: `aria-label` alone is not allowed on a plain span.
    this.dom.setAttribute('role', 'img');
    this.name = document.createElement('span');
    this.name.className = 'song-chord-name';
    this.name.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    this.dom.append(this.name);
    this.dom.addEventListener('click', this.select);

    views.add(this);
    this.render();
  }

  /** Writes the name and label for the current key and toggle; only what changed, so an unchanged name costs no layout. */
  render(): void {
    const label = chordLabelOf(this.node.attrs as ChordAtomAttrs, this.naming());
    if (this.name.textContent !== label.text) this.name.textContent = label.text;
    if (this.dom.getAttribute('aria-label') !== label.spoken) this.dom.setAttribute('aria-label', label.spoken);
  }

  update(node: Node): boolean {
    if (node.type !== this.node.type) return false;
    this.node = node;
    this.render();
    return true;
  }

  /** The view's own spacing and the name's text are this view's business: nothing for ProseMirror to re-read. */
  ignoreMutation(): boolean {
    return true;
  }

  destroy(): void {
    this.dom.removeEventListener('click', this.select);
    this.views.delete(this);
  }

  /**
   * A click on the name selects the chord, as a `NodeSelection` - what the popover (task 7), Alt+arrows and Delete act
   * on. On `click`, not `mousedown`, so pressing and dragging the name still drags the chord to another word: the
   * browser fires `click` only for a press that did not become a drag.
   */
  private readonly select = (): void => {
    const pos = this.getPos();
    if (pos === undefined) return;
    this.view.dispatch(this.view.state.tr.setSelection(NodeSelection.create(this.view.state.doc, pos)));
    this.view.focus();
  };
}

/**
 * Pads chords whose names would collide (see the file comment), across every lyric line under `root`, and takes the
 * padding off chords that no longer need it.
 *
 * Left to right through each line, each chord is compared with the name before it on the same row: a line that wraps
 * starts again on its next row. A chord's own box starts where it sits in the words whatever its padding, so the
 * padding each one needs is worked out from where it would be unpadded, and the result does not depend on the padding
 * it had - measuring twice gives the same answer. Writes happen only where the padding changes, so a measure that finds
 * nothing to change forces no layout but its first read.
 */
export function spaceChordNames(root: HTMLElement): void {
  for (const line of Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.song-lyric-line'))) spaceLine(line);
}

function spaceLine(line: HTMLElement): void {
  let previous: { right: number; top: number } | null = null;
  let gap: number | null = null;

  for (const chord of Array.from(line.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.song-chord'))) {
    const name = chord.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.song-chord-name');
    if (name === null) continue;
    gap ??= parseFloat(getComputedStyle(name).fontSize) * NAME_GAP_EM;

    let box = chord.getBoundingClientRect();
    const sameRow = previous !== null && Math.abs(box.top - previous.top) < 1;
    const needed = previous !== null && sameRow ? Math.max(0, previous.right + gap - box.left) : 0;
    const current = parseFloat(chord.style.paddingLeft) || 0;
    if (Math.abs(needed - current) >= 0.5) {
      chord.style.paddingLeft = needed > 0 ? `${needed}px` : '';
      box = chord.getBoundingClientRect();
    }
    previous = { right: name.getBoundingClientRect().right, top: box.top };
  }
}

/**
 * The plugin that measures the names after every update of the view, and once when it starts.
 *
 * After every update rather than only when a chord changes, because typing a letter between two chords moves them
 * apart as surely as adding one moves them together. What the view cannot see - the lyric size, the window's width,
 * a font arriving late - the sheet answers by calling `spaceChordNames` itself.
 */
export function chordSpacingPlugin(): Plugin {
  return new Plugin({
    view: view => {
      spaceChordNames(view.dom);
      return { update: next => spaceChordNames(next.dom) };
    }
  });
}
```

```ts
import { Plugin, TextSelection } from 'prosemirror-state';
import { Decoration, DecorationSet } from 'prosemirror-view';
import { songSchema } from '../../../services/song-schema';

/** The hint an empty lyric line shows where the caret is. */
export const LYRIC_PLACEHOLDER = 'Lyrics…';

/**
 * A faint "Lyrics…" on the empty line holding the caret, and nowhere else.
 *
 * **Only there**, rather than on every empty line: a song is full of empty lines - the gap between two verses' halves,
 * a line left for words still to come - and a hint on each would fill the sheet with grey. The one under the caret
 * says where typing goes, which is the only thing a hint is for. It covers a new song too: the editor starts with the
 * caret in the first line of the first section, so an empty song shows the hint there.
 *
 * **The caret's line, not the focused one**: it shows whether or not the sheet has the focus, because the caret is
 * still where typing will resume, and a hint that came and went as the toolbar took the focus would flicker for
 * nothing. A decoration of the line's node - a class and a `data-placeholder` its `::before` prints - so the hint is
 * never text in the document, and the caret sits before it.
 */
export function lyricPlaceholderPlugin(): Plugin {
  return new Plugin({
    props: {
      decorations: state => {
        const selection = state.selection;
        if (!(selection instanceof TextSelection) || !selection.empty) return null;
        const $caret = selection.$head;
        const line = $caret.parent;
        if (line.type !== songSchema.nodes.lyricLine || line.content.size > 0) return null;

        const start = $caret.before();
        return DecorationSet.create(state.doc, [
          Decoration.node(start, start + line.nodeSize, {
            class: 'is-placeholder',
            'data-placeholder': LYRIC_PLACEHOLDER
          })
        ]);
      }
    }
  });
}
```

```ts
import { Node } from 'prosemirror-model';
import type { EditorState } from 'prosemirror-state';
import type { NodeView, ViewMutationRecord } from 'prosemirror-view';
import type { SectionKind } from '../../../models/song.model';
import {
  SongEdit,
  commandOf,
  deleteSection,
  duplicateSection,
  moveSection,
  renameSection
} from '../../../services/song-commands';
import { sectionHeadingOf } from '../../../services/song-editor-plugins';

/**
 * A section on the sheet: its header - `[Verse 1]` and a ⋮ menu - over the section's lines.
 *
 * The header is not text in the document. It is drawn by this node view outside the section's `contentDOM`, marked
 * `contenteditable=false`, and ProseMirror is told to leave its events and its DOM alone (`stopEvent`,
 * `ignoreMutation`), so the caret never enters it and a click on its menu is the menu's. The label it shows is the
 * section node's `label` attribute, changed only through the menu's Rename - a command, so an undo step.
 *
 * Built with the DOM directly rather than as an Angular component: a node view is made and thrown away by
 * ProseMirror as sections are added, moved and undone, and an Angular view per section would have to be created,
 * attached and destroyed in step with it for a header and five buttons.
 */

/** What the sheet gives each section header: a way to run its commands, and to say what it did. */
export interface SectionHost {
  /** Runs `edit` on the sheet's view; true when it changed the song, false when refused (and reported) or unchanged. */
  run(edit: SongEdit): boolean;
  /** The editor's state now, to ask which menu items could run. */
  state(): EditorState;
  /** A polite message for the page's live region. */
  notify(message: string): void;
  /** Gives the focus back to the lyrics. */
  focusEditor(): void;
  /** Focuses the ⋮ button of the section `id`, wherever it now is. */
  focusSectionMenu(id: string): void;
}

/** How each kind is written where the sheet names one: the "+ Section" menu, and a header whose label does not say it. */
export const SECTION_KIND_NAMES: Readonly<Record<SectionKind, string>> = Object.freeze({
  intro: 'Intro',
  verse: 'Verse',
  pre: 'Pre-Chorus',
  chorus: 'Chorus',
  bridge: 'Bridge',
  outro: 'Outro',
  other: 'Section'
});

type MenuAction = 'rename' | 'up' | 'down' | 'duplicate' | 'delete';

const MENU_ITEMS: readonly { action: MenuAction; text: string }[] = [
  { action: 'rename', text: 'Rename' },
  { action: 'up', text: 'Move up' },
  { action: 'down', text: 'Move down' },
  { action: 'duplicate', text: 'Duplicate' },
  { action: 'delete', text: 'Delete' }
];

/** Gives each menu a distinct id for `aria-controls`; a section's own id would repeat while a copy is being pasted. */
let menuCount = 0;

function element<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, className: string): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K] {
  const created = document.createElement(tag);
  created.className = className;
  return created;
}

/**
 * The kind a renamed section takes: the kind its new name says, when the name is one of the six section words
 * (`sectionHeadingOf`, the `[Chorus]` rule's reading), and otherwise the kind it had. Renaming "Verse 1" to "Chorus"
 * makes it a chorus, as typing `[Chorus]` would; renaming a chorus to "Hook" keeps it a chorus, since "Hook" says
 * nothing about what it is.
 */
export function renamedKindOf(label: string, current: SectionKind): SectionKind {
  const heading = sectionHeadingOf(label);
  return heading === null || heading.kind === 'other' ? current : heading.kind;
}

export class SectionView implements NodeView {
  readonly dom: HTMLElement;
  readonly contentDOM: HTMLElement;

  private readonly header: HTMLElement;
  private readonly labelText: HTMLElement;
  private readonly kindTag: HTMLElement;
  private readonly heading: HTMLElement;
  private readonly toggle: HTMLButtonElement;
  private readonly menu: HTMLElement;
  private readonly items: HTMLButtonElement[];
  private readonly renameField: HTMLInputElement;
  private renaming = false;

  constructor(
    private node: Node,
    private readonly host: SectionHost
  ) {
    this.dom = element('section', 'song-section');
    this.header = element('div', 'song-section-header');
    this.header.contentEditable = 'false';

    this.heading = element('span', 'song-section-label');
    const open = element('span', 'song-section-bracket');
    open.textContent = '[';
    open.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    const close = element('span', 'song-section-bracket');
    close.textContent = ']';
    close.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    this.labelText = element('span', 'song-section-name');
    this.heading.append(open, this.labelText, close);
    this.kindTag = element('span', 'song-section-kind');

    this.renameField = element('input', 'song-section-rename');
    this.renameField.type = 'text';
    this.renameField.hidden = true;
    this.renameField.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Section name');
    this.renameField.addEventListener('keydown', this.onRenameKey);
    this.renameField.addEventListener('blur', this.onRenameBlur);

    const menuId = `song-section-menu-${++menuCount}`;
    this.toggle = element('button', 'song-section-menu-toggle');
    this.toggle.type = 'button';
    this.toggle.textContent = '⋮';
    this.toggle.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'menu');
    this.toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    this.toggle.setAttribute('aria-controls', menuId);
    this.toggle.addEventListener('click', this.onToggle);

    this.menu = element('div', 'song-section-menu');
    this.menu.id = menuId;
    this.menu.setAttribute('role', 'menu');
    this.menu.hidden = true;
    this.menu.addEventListener('keydown', this.onMenuKey);
    this.items = MENU_ITEMS.map(({ action, text }) => {
      const item = element('button', 'song-section-menu-item');
      item.type = 'button';
      item.textContent = text;
      item.setAttribute('role', 'menuitem');
      item.tabIndex = -1;
      item.dataset['action'] = action;
      item.addEventListener('click', () => this.choose(action));
      return item;
    });
    this.menu.append(...this.items);

    const menuWrap = element('div', 'song-section-menu-wrap');
    menuWrap.append(this.toggle, this.menu);
    this.header.append(this.heading, this.renameField, this.kindTag, menuWrap);

    this.contentDOM = element('div', 'song-section-body');
    this.dom.append(this.header, this.contentDOM);
    this.render();
  }

  update(node: Node): boolean {
    if (node.type !== this.node.type) return false;
    this.node = node;
    this.render();
    return true;
  }

  /** Every event in the header is the header's: ProseMirror must not turn a click on ⋮ into a caret. */
  stopEvent(event: Event): boolean {
    return event.target instanceof globalThis.Node && this.header.contains(event.target);
  }

  /** Only the lines are ProseMirror's to re-read; the header and the section's own attributes are this view's. */
  ignoreMutation(mutation: ViewMutationRecord): boolean {
    return !this.contentDOM.contains(mutation.target);
  }

  destroy(): void {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this.onOutside, true);
  }

  private get id(): string {
    return this.node.attrs['id'];
  }

  private get label(): string {
    return this.node.attrs['label'];
  }

  private get kind(): SectionKind {
    return this.node.attrs['kind'];
  }

  /** The header for the node now: its label, its kind when the label does not say it, and its menu's name. */
  private render(): void {
    this.dom.dataset['sectionId'] = this.id ?? '';
    this.dom.dataset['kind'] = this.kind;
    this.labelText.textContent = this.label;
    // "Verse 2" says it is a verse; "Middle eight" does not say it is a bridge, so the kind is shown beside it.
    const said = sectionHeadingOf(this.label)?.kind;
    this.kindTag.textContent = said === this.kind ? '' : SECTION_KIND_NAMES[this.kind];
    this.kindTag.hidden = said === this.kind;
    this.toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', `${this.label}: section menu`);
    this.menu.setAttribute('aria-label', this.label);
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // The menu
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  private readonly onToggle = (): void => {
    if (this.menu.hidden) this.openMenu();
    else this.closeMenu(true);
  };

  /**
   * Opens the menu with the focus on its first item. Each item that could not run now - Move up on the first section,
   * Delete on the only one - is dimmed (`aria-disabled`) but stays in the menu and can still be pressed, which says why
   * not in the live region rather than leaving the reader to guess.
   */
  private openMenu(): void {
    const state = this.host.state();
    for (const item of this.items) {
      const edit = this.editFor(item.dataset['action'] as MenuAction);
      const runnable = edit === null || commandOf(edit)(state);
      item.setAttribute('aria-disabled', String(!runnable));
    }
    this.menu.hidden = false;
    this.toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    this.toggle.classList.add('on');
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', this.onOutside, true);
    this.items[0].focus();
  }

  private closeMenu(refocus: boolean): void {
    if (this.menu.hidden) return;
    this.menu.hidden = true;
    this.toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    this.toggle.classList.remove('on');
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this.onOutside, true);
    if (refocus) this.toggle.focus();
  }

  /** A press anywhere outside the menu and its button closes it, leaving the focus wherever the press put it. */
  private readonly onOutside = (event: MouseEvent): void => {
    const target = event.target;
    if (target instanceof globalThis.Node && (this.menu.contains(target) || this.toggle.contains(target))) return;
    this.closeMenu(false);
  };

  /** The menu's keys, as the ARIA menu pattern has them: arrows walk it and wrap, Home and End jump, Escape and Tab leave. */
  private readonly onMenuKey = (event: KeyboardEvent): void => {
    const index = this.items.findIndex(item => item === document.activeElement);
    const last = this.items.length - 1;
    const move = (to: number): void => {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.items[to].focus();
    };
    switch (event.key) {
      case 'ArrowDown':
        return move(index >= last ? 0 : index + 1);
      case 'ArrowUp':
        return move(index <= 0 ? last : index - 1);
      case 'Home':
        return move(0);
      case 'End':
        return move(last);
      case 'Escape':
        event.preventDefault();
        // The shell closes its drawer on Escape too; this one is the menu's.
        event.stopPropagation();
        return this.closeMenu(true);
      case 'Tab':
        return this.closeMenu(false);
    }
  };

  /** The edit an item runs, or null for Rename, which opens a field first. */
  private editFor(action: MenuAction): SongEdit | null {
    switch (action) {
      case 'rename':
        return null;
      case 'up':
        return moveSection(this.id, -1);
      case 'down':
        return moveSection(this.id, 1);
      case 'duplicate':
        return duplicateSection(this.id);
      case 'delete':
        return deleteSection(this.id);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Runs an item, then puts the focus where the user will want it next.
   *
   * - **Move up / down**: back on this section's ⋮, wherever the section now is - a moved section is a new node view,
   *   so the button is found again by id - so pressing again moves it again.
   * - **Duplicate**: in the copy's first line, where the command puts the caret.
   * - **Delete**: in the lyrics, since the menu went with its section. **No confirm**: a deleted section is one Undo
   *   away (Ctrl+Z, or the toolbar's Undo), ids and all, which a dialog in front of every delete would only slow; the
   *   live region says so. The library's song delete asks because it has no undo.
   */
  private choose(action: MenuAction): void {
    this.closeMenu(false);
    const edit = this.editFor(action);
    if (edit === null) {
      this.startRename();
      return;
    }

    const { id, label } = this;
    const changed = this.host.run(edit);
    if (action === 'up' || action === 'down') {
      this.host.focusSectionMenu(id);
    } else if (!changed) {
      this.toggle.focus();
    } else {
      this.host.focusEditor();
      this.host.notify(action === 'delete' ? `Deleted ${label}. Undo brings it back.` : `Duplicated ${label}.`);
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Rename
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  private startRename(): void {
    this.renaming = true;
    this.renameField.value = this.label;
    this.heading.hidden = true;
    this.renameField.hidden = false;
    this.renameField.focus();
    this.renameField.select();
  }

  /**
   * Ends the rename, applying it unless `apply` is false. The new name takes its kind by `renamedKindOf`. A blank
   * name is refused by the command and said in the live region; the old name stays.
   */
  private finishRename(apply: boolean): void {
    if (!this.renaming) return;
    this.renaming = false;
    const label = this.renameField.value;
    this.renameField.hidden = true;
    this.heading.hidden = false;
    // Back to the button before the command runs, so the field's blur - fired as it is hidden - finds nothing to do.
    this.toggle.focus();
    if (apply) this.host.run(renameSection(this.id, label, renamedKindOf(label, this.kind)));
  }

  private readonly onRenameKey = (event: KeyboardEvent): void => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.finishRename(true);
    } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      this.finishRename(false);
    }
  };

  /** Leaving the field by Tab or a click keeps what was typed, as any text field does. */
  private readonly onRenameBlur = (): void => this.finishRename(true);
}
```
