```scss
// The sheet's colours, as the song pages name them, each with its own value as the fallback so the sheet renders the
// same in its own specs, outside the page that sets them. Chord names are the app's in-scale blue, lightened to read
// on the dark surface (6:1); a selected chord takes the accent the flat tools use for "this one".
:host {
  --sheet-text: var(--songs-text, #ecf0f1);
  --sheet-text-dim: var(--songs-text-dim, #adbcc8);
  --sheet-chord: #5dade2;
  --sheet-accent: var(--songs-accent, #3498db);
  --sheet-menu: var(--songs-bar, #2c3e50);
  --sheet-border: var(--songs-border, #465666);

  display: block;
}

// The three lyric sizes `Aa` steps through. Names, headers and the room above each line are all in `em` of this.
.song-sheet {
  --lyric-size: 1.1rem;

  &[data-lyric-size='small'] {
    --lyric-size: 0.95rem;
  }

  &[data-lyric-size='large'] {
    --lyric-size: 1.35rem;
  }
}

// Everything below is ProseMirror's DOM or a node view's, which Angular's emulated encapsulation never marks - hence
// `::ng-deep`, kept under `:host .song-sheet` so nothing outside the sheet is touched.
:host ::ng-deep .song-sheet {
  // prosemirror-view's own stylesheet (`style/prosemirror.css`), which whitespace and the caret depend on, restated
  // here rather than added to the global bundle every page downloads.
  .ProseMirror {
    position: relative;
    word-wrap: break-word;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    font-variant-ligatures: none;
    font-feature-settings: 'liga' 0;
  }

  .ProseMirror-hideselection *::selection {
    background: transparent;
  }

  .ProseMirror-hideselection {
    caret-color: transparent;
  }

  .ProseMirror [draggable][contenteditable='false'] {
    user-select: text;
  }

  img.ProseMirror-separator {
    display: inline !important;
    border: none !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
  }

  .song-sheet-editor {
    min-height: 100%;
    padding: 1rem 2rem 6rem;
    outline: none;
    color: var(--sheet-text);
    caret-color: var(--sheet-text);
    // Monospace, so a letter is a letter's width and a chord over the fifth letter of a line is over the fifth
    // letter of every copy of it - and a chord sheet copied out as text keeps its columns.
    font-family: ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;
    font-size: var(--lyric-size);
  }

  .song-section {
    margin-bottom: 1.25em;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // The section header: `[Verse 1]` and its ⋮ menu
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  .song-section-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4em;
    min-height: 2em;
    user-select: none;
    color: var(--sheet-text-dim);
  }

  .song-section-label {
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--sheet-text);
  }

  .song-section-bracket {
    color: var(--sheet-text-dim);
  }

  .song-section-kind {
    font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }

  .song-section-rename {
    width: 14em;
    padding: 0.15em 0.4em;
    background-color: var(--songs-surface, #1a252f);
    border: 1px solid var(--sheet-border);
    border-radius: 3px;
    color: var(--sheet-text);
    font: inherit;
    font-weight: 700;

    &:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--sheet-text);
      outline-offset: -1px;
    }
  }

  .song-section-menu-wrap {
    position: relative;
  }

  // The flat tool style: no chrome until hovered, colour only while its menu is open.
  .song-section-menu-toggle,
  .song-section-menu-item {
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 3px;
    color: var(--sheet-text);
    font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background-color 90ms ease-out;

    &:hover:not(.on) {
      background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 10%);
    }

    &:active {
      background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 16%);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--sheet-text);
      outline-offset: -2px;
    }
  }

  .song-section-menu-toggle {
    padding: 0.1rem 0.45rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    color: var(--sheet-text-dim);

    &.on {
      background-color: var(--sheet-accent);
      color: #fff;
    }
  }

  .song-section-menu {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 0.25rem);
    left: 0;
    z-index: 60;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 9rem;
    padding: 0.25rem;
    background-color: var(--sheet-menu);
    border: 1px solid var(--sheet-border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 40%);

    &[hidden] {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  .song-section-menu-item {
    padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
    text-align: left;

    // Dimmed, not hidden: pressing it says why it cannot run.
    &[aria-disabled='true'] {
      opacity: 0.42;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Lyric lines and the chords over them
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  // Every line keeps the room above it for a row of names, whether or not it has chords yet, so placing the first
  // chord on a line never shifts the lines below it.
  .song-lyric-line {
    margin: 0;
    padding-top: 1.25em;
    line-height: 1.35;
    min-height: 1.35em;

    &.is-placeholder::before {
      content: attr(data-placeholder);
      float: left;
      height: 0;
      color: var(--sheet-text-dim);
      opacity: 0.6;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
  }

  // Zero wide: no content in the flow, only the name positioned out of it. Left padding, set by `spaceChordNames`,
  // is how a collision widens the line.
  .song-chord {
    position: relative;
  }

  // At the span's right edge - where its letter starts - and just above the line.
  .song-chord-name {
    position: absolute;
    left: 100%;
    bottom: 100%;
    border-radius: 2px;
    color: var(--sheet-chord);
    font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.2;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
  }

  .song-chord.ProseMirror-selectednode {
    outline: none;

    // The highlight reaches past the name by a shadow rather than padding, so the name does not move off its letter.
    .song-chord-name {
      background-color: var(--sheet-accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.15em var(--sheet-accent);
      color: #fff;
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
import {
  AfterViewChecked,
  AfterViewInit,
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  NgZone,
  OnChanges,
  OnDestroy,
  Output,
  SimpleChanges,
  ViewChild,
  inject
} from '@angular/core';
import { redo, redoDepth, undo, undoDepth } from 'prosemirror-history';
import { Node } from 'prosemirror-model';
import { EditorState, Transaction } from 'prosemirror-state';
import { EditorView } from 'prosemirror-view';
import { SongEdit, SongKeyRules, commandOf } from '../../../services/song-commands';
import { songMetaOf } from '../../../services/song-document';
import { ChordFieldRequest, songEditorPlugins } from '../../../services/song-editor-plugins';
import { LyricSize } from '../../../services/song-sheet-preferences.service';
import { ChordNaming, ChordView, chordSpacingPlugin, spaceChordNames } from './chord-view';
import { lyricPlaceholderPlugin } from './lyric-placeholder';
import { SectionHost, SectionView } from './section-view';

/** Whether the song's history has a step to undo and one to redo: what the toolbar's Undo and Redo show. */
export interface SheetHistory {
  canUndo: boolean;
  canRedo: boolean;
}

/**
 * The song sheet: the ProseMirror editor that holds a song's words, chords and sections (design Part 2).
 *
 * **It owns the editor and nothing else.** The document's state is ProseMirror's `EditorState`, which this component
 * creates from `initialDoc` and keeps; the page learns of every change through `docChanged` and saves it, and changes
 * the song only by handing a `SongEdit` to `run`, so the toolbar's key, tempo and section commands act on this one
 * view and land in its one history. Taken as an input once, `initialDoc` is not watched: the page shows a sheet only
 * for a loaded song, and a different song is a different sheet.
 *
 * **Outside Angular's zone.** The view and its DOM listeners are created outside it, so a keystroke, a selection change
 * or a pointer move over the lyrics runs no change detection; the zone is re-entered only to emit. ProseMirror needs
 * nothing from Angular, and the sheet is the busiest surface on the page.
 *
 * **What the page shows it with** - names or numerals, the lyric size, the key rules chord names are worked out by -
 * are inputs, because they are the viewer's or the app's and not the song's (`SongSheetPreferencesService`). A change
 * to any of them, or to the song's key, re-renders every chord's name and measures the lines again.
 *
 * Its styles reach into ProseMirror's DOM with `:host ::ng-deep` under `.song-sheet`, which this component owns: that
 * DOM is built outside Angular's templates, so emulated encapsulation never marks it (brief decision 10).
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-song-sheet',
  standalone: true,
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  templateUrl: './song-sheet.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./song-sheet.component.scss']
})
export class SongSheetComponent implements AfterViewInit, AfterViewChecked, OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  /** The song to edit, as `songNodeOf` accepted it. Read once, when the editor is made. */
  @Input() initialDoc: Node | null = null;
  /** The app's rules for keys and scales: a chord's name needs the scale its key's id names. */
  @Input() keys: Pick<SongKeyRules, 'chordScaleFor'> | null = null;
  /** Roman numerals over the words rather than chord names. */
  @Input() numerals = false;
  @Input() lyricSize: LyricSize = 'medium';

  /** Every new document, after any change to it - typing, a command, an undo. */
  @Output() readonly docChanged = new EventEmitter<Node>();
  /** Why a command - from `run`, a key, or a section's menu - was refused. */
  @Output() readonly refused = new EventEmitter<string>();
  /** What a section's menu did, for the page's live region: "Deleted Verse 2. Undo brings it back." */
  @Output() readonly notice = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() readonly historyChanged = new EventEmitter<SheetHistory>();
  /**
   * `[` pressed on a line with words: the chord field is wanted at `pos` (task 7). Only while something listens - with
   * nothing bound, `[` is typed as itself, so the sheet never swallows a key it has no answer for.
   */
  @Output() readonly chordFieldRequested = new EventEmitter<ChordFieldRequest>();

  @ViewChild('mount', { static: true }) private mount?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  private readonly zone = inject(NgZone);
  private view: EditorView | null = null;
  /** Every chord's view now on the sheet, so a key or toggle change can re-render them all. */
  private readonly chordViews = new Set<ChordView>();
  private naming: ChordNaming = { key: { tonic: 0, scaleId: 'ionian', preferSharps: true }, scaleIntervals: null, numerals: false };
  private history: SheetHistory = { canUndo: false, canRedo: false };
  private resizes: ResizeObserver | null = null;
  /** Set when an input changed what the lines look like; the lines are measured once the view has caught up. */
  private remeasureDue = false;

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    const doc = this.initialDoc;
    const mount = this.mount?.nativeElement;
    if (doc === null || mount === undefined) return;

    this.naming = this.namingFor(doc);
    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      const listening = this.chordFieldRequested.observed;
      const state = EditorState.create({
        doc,
        plugins: [
          ...songEditorPlugins({
            onChordFieldRequest: listening
              ? request => this.zone.run(() => this.chordFieldRequested.emit(request))
              : undefined,
            onRefuse: reason => this.zone.run(() => this.refused.emit(reason))
          }),
          lyricPlaceholderPlugin(),
          chordSpacingPlugin()
        ]
      });

      this.view = new EditorView(mount, {
        state,
        dispatchTransaction: tr => this.dispatch(tr),
        nodeViews: {
          chord: (node, view, getPos) => new ChordView(node, view, getPos, () => this.naming, this.chordViews),
          section: (node, view) => new SectionView(node, this.sectionHost(view))
        },
        attributes: {
          class: 'song-sheet-editor',
          role: 'textbox',
          'aria-multiline': 'true',
          'aria-label': 'Lyrics and chords',
          spellcheck: 'true'
        }
      });

      // A narrower window wraps lines differently, and a late font changes every name's width: both move collisions.
      this.resizes = new ResizeObserver(() => this.remeasure());
      this.resizes.observe(mount);
      void document.fonts?.ready.then(() => this.remeasure());
    });
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (this.view === null) return;
    if (changes['numerals'] || changes['keys']) {
      this.naming = this.namingFor(this.view.state.doc);
      this.renderChords();
    }
    if (changes['numerals'] || changes['keys'] || changes['lyricSize']) this.remeasureDue = true;
  }

  /** The lyric size is a binding, so its lines are measured only after this view has applied it. */
  ngAfterViewChecked(): void {
    if (!this.remeasureDue) return;
    this.remeasureDue = false;
    this.remeasure();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.resizes?.disconnect();
    this.view?.destroy();
    this.view = null;
  }

  /**
   * Runs a song command on the sheet: dispatched as one undo step when it changes something, its reason emitted on
   * `refused` when it is refused. True when the song changed.
   */
  run(edit: SongEdit): boolean {
    const view = this.view;
    if (view === null) return false;
    return commandOf(edit, reason => this.zone.run(() => this.refused.emit(reason)))(view.state, tr => this.dispatch(tr));
  }

  undo(): boolean {
    const view = this.view;
    return view !== null && undo(view.state, tr => this.dispatch(tr));
  }

  redo(): boolean {
    const view = this.view;
    return view !== null && redo(view.state, tr => this.dispatch(tr));
  }

  /** Puts the focus in the lyrics, at the caret. */
  focus(): void {
    this.view?.focus();
  }

  /** The editor's state now, or null before the editor is made. */
  editorState(): EditorState | null {
    return this.view?.state ?? null;
  }

  /**
   * Applies a transaction - with whatever the plugins append to it - and tells the page what changed.
   *
   * A key change is seen here, by the doc's `key` attribute changing, and the chord names follow it in the same
   * dispatch: the naming is swapped before the view updates, so a chord the change rewrote renders in the new key, and
   * every other chord is re-rendered after.
   */
  private dispatch(tr: Transaction): void {
    const view = this.view;
    if (view === null) return;
    const before = view.state;
    const state = before.apply(tr);
    const rekeyed = state.doc.attrs['key'] !== before.doc.attrs['key'];
    if (rekeyed) this.naming = this.namingFor(state.doc);

    view.updateState(state);
    if (rekeyed) {
      this.renderChords();
      this.remeasure();
    }

    const history: SheetHistory = { canUndo: undoDepth(state) > 0, canRedo: redoDepth(state) > 0 };
    const historyMoved = history.canUndo !== this.history.canUndo || history.canRedo !== this.history.canRedo;
    this.history = history;
    if (state.doc === before.doc && !historyMoved) return;

    this.zone.run(() => {
      if (state.doc !== before.doc) this.docChanged.emit(state.doc);
      if (historyMoved) this.historyChanged.emit(history);
    });
  }

  private namingFor(doc: Node): ChordNaming {
    const key = songMetaOf(doc).key;
    return { key, scaleIntervals: this.keys?.chordScaleFor(key) ?? null, numerals: this.numerals };
  }

  private renderChords(): void {
    for (const chord of this.chordViews) chord.render();
  }

  private remeasure(): void {
    if (this.view !== null) spaceChordNames(this.view.dom);
  }

  /** What one section's header may do on this sheet. */
  private sectionHost(view: EditorView): SectionHost {
    return {
      run: edit => this.run(edit),
      state: () => view.state,
      notify: message => this.zone.run(() => this.notice.emit(message)),
      focusEditor: () => view.focus(),
      focusSectionMenu: id =>
        view.dom
          .querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-section-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"] .song-section-menu-toggle`)
          ?.focus()
    };
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="song-toolbar" role="toolbar" aria-label="Song" *ngIf="meta as meta">
  <!-- Dimmed, not hidden, when there is nothing to undo: a press then does nothing, as Ctrl+Z does. -->
  <div class="group">
    <button
      type="button"
      class="tool undo"
      aria-label="Undo"
      title="Undo (Ctrl+Z)"
      [attr.aria-disabled]="!canUndo"
      (click)="undo.emit()"
    >
      <svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
        <path d="M9 14 4 9l5-5" />
        <path d="M4 9h10.5a5.5 5.5 0 0 1 0 11H11" />
      </svg>
    </button>
    <button
      type="button"
      class="tool redo"
      aria-label="Redo"
      title="Redo (Ctrl+Y)"
      [attr.aria-disabled]="!canRedo"
      (click)="redo.emit()"
    >
      <svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
        <path d="m15 14 5-5-5-5" />
        <path d="M20 9H9.5a5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0 11H13" />
      </svg>
    </button>
  </div>

  <div class="group" role="group" aria-label="Key">
    <span class="field-label" aria-hidden="true">Key</span>
    <select #tonic class="key-tonic" aria-label="Key: tonic" (change)="chooseTonic(tonic)">
      <option *ngFor="let option of tonicOptions; trackBy: trackByValue" [value]="option.value" [selected]="option.value === tonicValue">
        {{ option.label }}
      </option>
    </select>
    <select #scale class="key-scale" aria-label="Key: scale" (change)="chooseScale(scale)">
      <option *ngIf="unlistedScale" [value]="meta.key.scaleId" disabled selected>{{ unlistedScale }}</option>
      <optgroup *ngFor="let group of scaleGroups; trackBy: trackByName" [label]="group.name">
        <option *ngFor="let entry of group.scales" [value]="entry.id" [selected]="entry.id === meta.key.scaleId">
          {{ entry.name }}
        </option>
      </optgroup>
    </select>
    <button type="button" class="tool transpose-up" aria-label="Transpose up a semitone" title="Transpose up a semitone" (click)="transpose(1)">↑</button>
    <button type="button" class="tool transpose-down" aria-label="Transpose down a semitone" title="Transpose down a semitone" (click)="transpose(-1)">↓</button>
  </div>

  <div class="group">
    <label class="field">
      <span class="field-label">BPM</span>
      <input
        #tempo
        type="number"
        class="song-tempo"
        [min]="tempoMin"
        [max]="tempoMax"
        step="1"
        [value]="meta.tempo"
        (change)="commitTempo(tempo)"
      />
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="group meter" role="group" aria-label="Time signature">
    <select #numerator class="meter-numerator" aria-label="Beats in a bar" (change)="chooseMeter('numerator', numerator)">
      <option *ngFor="let beats of numerators" [value]="beats" [selected]="beats === meta.timeSignature.numerator">{{ beats }}</option>
    </select>
    <span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
    <select #denominator class="meter-denominator" aria-label="Beat note value" (change)="chooseMeter('denominator', denominator)">
      <option *ngFor="let value of denominators" [value]="value" [selected]="value === meta.timeSignature.denominator">{{ value }}</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="group">
    <button
      type="button"
      class="tool numerals-toggle"
      [class.on]="preferences.numerals"
      [attr.aria-pressed]="preferences.numerals"
      title="Show Roman numerals instead of chord names"
      (click)="toggleNumerals()"
    >I-IV</button>
    <button
      type="button"
      class="tool lyric-size"
      [attr.aria-label]="'Lyric size: ' + preferences.lyricSize"
      [title]="'Lyric size: ' + preferences.lyricSize + ' (next: ' + nextLyricSize + ')'"
      (click)="stepLyricSize()"
    >Aa</button>
  </div>

  <div class="group add-section" (keydown.escape)="closeSectionMenu(sectionToggle, $event)">
    <button
      #sectionToggle
      type="button"
      class="tool add-section-toggle"
      [class.on]="sectionMenuOpen"
      aria-haspopup="menu"
      aria-controls="song-add-section-menu"
      [attr.aria-expanded]="sectionMenuOpen"
      (click)="toggleSectionMenu()"
    >+ Section</button>
    <!-- Hidden with CSS rather than removed, so aria-controls always points at something. -->
    <div class="menu-panel" id="song-add-section-menu" role="menu" aria-label="Add a section" [class.open]="sectionMenuOpen">
      <button
        *ngFor="let kind of sectionKinds"
        type="button"
        role="menuitem"
        class="tool"
        [attr.data-kind]="kind"
        (click)="addSection(kind)"
      >{{ kindNames[kind] }}</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```scss
// The song pages' tokens, each with its own value as the fallback so the toolbar renders the same outside the page.
:host {
  --toolbar-bar: var(--songs-bar, #2c3e50);
  --toolbar-surface: var(--songs-surface, #1a252f);
  --toolbar-border: var(--songs-border, #465666);
  --toolbar-text: var(--songs-text, #ecf0f1);
  --toolbar-text-dim: var(--songs-text-dim, #adbcc8);
  --toolbar-accent: var(--songs-accent, #3498db);

  display: block;
}

.song-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem 1rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 1.5rem;
  background-color: var(--toolbar-bar);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--toolbar-border);
  color: var(--toolbar-text);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
}

.field {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.field-label {
  color: var(--toolbar-text-dim);
}

select,
input {
  padding: 0.3rem 0.4rem;
  background-color: var(--toolbar-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--toolbar-border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--toolbar-text);
  font: inherit;

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--toolbar-text);
    outline-offset: -1px;
  }
}

.key-scale {
  max-width: 14rem;
}

.song-tempo {
  width: 4.5rem;
}

// The flat tool style (composer palette): no chrome until hovered, colour only on the one that is on (`.on`).
.tool {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  min-width: 2rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.55rem;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--toolbar-text);
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 90ms ease-out;

  &:hover:not(.on) {
    background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 10%);
  }

  &:active {
    background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 16%);
  }

  &.on {
    background-color: var(--toolbar-accent);
    color: #fff;
  }

  &[aria-disabled='true'] {
    opacity: 0.42;
    cursor: not-allowed;
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--toolbar-text);
    outline-offset: -2px;
  }
}

.numerals-toggle {
  font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.add-section {
  position: relative;
}

.menu-panel {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 0.25rem);
  left: 0;
  z-index: 60;
  min-width: 9rem;
  padding: 0.25rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  background-color: var(--toolbar-bar);
  border: 1px solid var(--toolbar-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 40%);

  &.open {
    display: flex;
  }

  .tool {
    justify-content: flex-start;
    width: 100%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .song-toolbar {
    padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  ChangeDetectorRef,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  HostListener,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  OnDestroy,
  OnInit,
  Output,
  inject
} from '@angular/core';
import { Node } from 'prosemirror-model';
import { Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { takeUntil } from 'rxjs/operators';
import type { Scale } from '../../../models/music-theory.model';
import { TEMPO_MAX, TEMPO_MIN } from '../../../models/progression-normalize';
import { SECTION_KINDS, SectionKind, SongMeta } from '../../../models/song.model';
import { MusicTheoryService } from '../../../services/music-theory.service';
import type { ProgressionKeyContext } from '../../../services/progression-key-context';
import {
  SongEdit,
  addSection,
  copyLabelOf,
  setSongKey,
  setTempo,
  setTimeSignature,
  transposeSong
} from '../../../services/song-commands';
import { sectionsOf, songMetaOf } from '../../../services/song-document';
import {
  LYRIC_SIZES,
  LyricSize,
  SongSheetPreferences,
  SongSheetPreferencesService
} from '../../../services/song-sheet-preferences.service';
import { SECTION_KIND_NAMES } from '../song-sheet/section-view';

/** One entry in the tonic menu: a pitch class, and - for the five black keys - which of its two names. */
export interface TonicOption {
  /** `'0'` for C; `'1#'` / `'1b'` for C# / Db. */
  value: string;
  label: string;
  tonic: number;
  /** The spelling this entry picks, or null for a white key, whose spelling the key's signature decides. */
  preferSharps: boolean | null;
}

/** A category of scales a song can be in, for the scale menu's `<optgroup>`. */
export interface ScaleGroup {
  name: string;
  scales: readonly Scale[];
}

const SHARP_NAMES = ['C', 'C#', 'D', 'D#', 'E', 'F', 'F#', 'G', 'G#', 'A', 'A#', 'B'];
const FLAT_NAMES = ['C', 'Db', 'D', 'Eb', 'E', 'F', 'Gb', 'G', 'Ab', 'A', 'Bb', 'B'];

/**
 * The tonic menu: the seven white keys once and the five black keys under both names, C, C#, Db, D, ... B.
 *
 * Both names because a pitch class cannot say how a key is spelled, and the user can: F# major and Gb major are the
 * same notes written in six sharps or six flats, and which one a song is in is theirs to say. A white key is listed
 * once, its spelling left to its signature (`spellingFor`): F major is in flats and nobody means it any other way.
 * ASCII `#` and `b`, as chord names and the library's key names write them.
 */
export const TONIC_OPTIONS: readonly TonicOption[] = Object.freeze(
  SHARP_NAMES.flatMap((sharp, tonic): TonicOption[] => {
    const flat = FLAT_NAMES[tonic];
    if (sharp === flat) return [{ value: `${tonic}`, label: sharp, tonic, preferSharps: null }];
    return [
      { value: `${tonic}#`, label: sharp, tonic, preferSharps: true },
      { value: `${tonic}b`, label: flat, tonic, preferSharps: false }
    ];
  })
);

/** The tonic menu's entry for a key: its pitch class, and for a black key the spelling the key is in. */
export function tonicValueOf(tonic: number, preferSharps: boolean): string {
  const white = TONIC_OPTIONS.some(option => option.tonic === tonic && option.preferSharps === null);
  return white ? `${tonic}` : `${tonic}${preferSharps ? '#' : 'b'}`;
}

/** The meter menus' numbers: up to sixteen beats, over the four note values a song's beat is written in. */
const NUMERATORS: readonly number[] = Array.from({ length: 16 }, (_, index) => index + 1);
const DENOMINATORS: readonly number[] = [2, 4, 8, 16];

/**
 * The scale categories the key menu leaves out: `fretboardNotes` holds note filters for the fretboard - all notes,
 * the naturals, the sharps - not keys, though "Natural Notes" has seven notes a chord could be stacked through.
 */
const NOT_KEYS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['fretboardNotes']);

/**
 * A new section's name: its kind's name, and for a verse a number one past the highest verse already in the song.
 *
 * Verses are numbered because each has its own words; a chorus, an intro or a bridge is not, because a repeated
 * chorus is the same chorus - the rule `copyLabelOf` follows for a duplicate, whose numbering this reuses: a "Verse 0"
 * counted on past every "Verse N" the song has is the next verse.
 */
export function newSectionLabelOf(kind: SectionKind, labels: readonly string[]): string {
  const name = SECTION_KIND_NAMES[kind];
  return kind === 'verse' ? copyLabelOf(`${name} 0`, labels) : name;
}

/** The size after `size` in `Aa`'s round: small, medium, large, and small again. */
function nextLyricSizeOf(size: LyricSize): LyricSize {
  return LYRIC_SIZES[(LYRIC_SIZES.indexOf(size) + 1) % LYRIC_SIZES.length];
}

/**
 * The song's toolbar (design Part 2): Undo and Redo, the key and Transpose, BPM, the time signature, the
 * names/numerals toggle, the lyric size, and "+ Section".
 *
 * **It never changes the song itself.** Each control builds a `SongEdit` and emits it, and the page runs it on the
 * sheet, so every change lands in the sheet's one history and every refusal in the page's one live region. The two
 * display choices are the exception - they are not the song's - and go to `SongSheetPreferencesService`.
 *
 * **Its controls show the song, not what was last picked.** A refused or unchanged edit leaves the song as it was, and
 * a select whose bound value did not change would go on showing the refused pick: Angular writes a binding only when
 * it changes. So each handler puts its control back to the song's value as it emits, and the song's new value, if it
 * took, arrives with the next document through the bindings.
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-song-toolbar',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  templateUrl: './song-toolbar.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./song-toolbar.component.scss']
})
export class SongToolbarComponent implements OnInit, OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  /** The song now: what every control shows. */
  @Input() doc: Node | null = null;
  @Input() keys: ProgressionKeyContext | null = null;
  @Input() canUndo = false;
  @Input() canRedo = false;

  @Output() readonly edit = new EventEmitter<SongEdit>();
  @Output() readonly undo = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() readonly redo = new EventEmitter<void>();
  /** Something the toolbar did that the page's live region should say: a tempo held to its range. */
  @Output() readonly notice = new EventEmitter<string>();
  /** The lyrics should have the focus: a section was just added, with the caret in its first line. */
  @Output() readonly sheetFocus = new EventEmitter<void>();

  private readonly preferencesService = inject(SongSheetPreferencesService);
  private readonly musicTheory = inject(MusicTheoryService);
  private readonly changes = inject(ChangeDetectorRef);
  private readonly destroy$ = new Subject<void>();

  readonly tonicOptions = TONIC_OPTIONS;
  readonly numerators = NUMERATORS;
  readonly sectionKinds = SECTION_KINDS;
  readonly kindNames = SECTION_KIND_NAMES;
  readonly tempoMin = TEMPO_MIN;
  readonly tempoMax = TEMPO_MAX;

  meta: SongMeta | null = null;
  tonicValue = '0';
  scaleGroups: readonly ScaleGroup[] = [];
  /** The song's scale when the menu does not offer it - one saved by something other than this page - else null. */
  unlistedScale: string | null = null;
  denominators: readonly number[] = DENOMINATORS;
  preferences: SongSheetPreferences = this.preferencesService.preferences;
  /** The size `Aa` goes to next, for its tooltip. */
  nextLyricSize: LyricSize = nextLyricSizeOf(this.preferences.lyricSize);
  sectionMenuOpen = false;
  private labels: readonly string[] = [];

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.scaleGroups = this.musicTheory
      .getScaleCategories()
      .filter(category => !NOT_KEYS.has(category.id))
      .map(category => ({
        name: category.name,
        scales: category.scales.filter(scale => this.keys !== null && this.keys.chordScale(scale) !== null)
      }))
      .filter(group => group.scales.length > 0);
    this.describeScale();

    this.preferencesService.preferences$.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$)).subscribe(preferences => {
      this.preferences = preferences;
      this.nextLyricSize = nextLyricSizeOf(preferences.lyricSize);
      this.changes.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    if (this.doc === null) return;
    const meta = songMetaOf(this.doc);
    this.meta = meta;
    this.labels = sectionsOf(this.doc).map(section => section.label);
    this.tonicValue = tonicValueOf(meta.key.tonic, meta.key.preferSharps);
    const denominator = meta.timeSignature.denominator;
    this.denominators = DENOMINATORS.includes(denominator) ? DENOMINATORS : [...DENOMINATORS, denominator].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    this.describeScale();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  /**
   * A tonic picked: a black key's entry says how the key is spelled, a white key's leaves it to the signature. The
   * scale stays.
   */
  chooseTonic(select: HTMLSelectElement): void {
    const option = TONIC_OPTIONS.find(entry => entry.value === select.value);
    select.value = this.tonicValue;
    if (option === undefined || this.meta === null || this.keys === null) return;
    this.edit.emit(setSongKey(this.keys, option.tonic, this.meta.key.scaleId, option.preferSharps ?? undefined));
  }

  /**
   * A scale picked: the tonic stays, and the spelling is worked out afresh for the new key - C ionian to C aeolian goes
   * to flats - as Transpose does, rather than carried from a key whose signature it was.
   */
  chooseScale(select: HTMLSelectElement): void {
    const scaleId = select.value;
    select.value = this.meta?.key.scaleId ?? scaleId;
    if (this.meta === null || this.keys === null) return;
    this.edit.emit(setSongKey(this.keys, this.meta.key.tonic, scaleId));
  }

  transpose(delta: -1 | 1): void {
    if (this.keys !== null) this.edit.emit(transposeSong(this.keys, delta));
  }

  /**
   * The BPM field committed (Enter, or leaving it): a whole number held to the range the progression page plays, with
   * the live region saying so when it was held; anything that is not a number puts the song's tempo back.
   */
  commitTempo(input: HTMLInputElement): void {
    const current = this.meta?.tempo;
    if (current === undefined) return;
    const typed = input.value.trim() === '' ? NaN : Math.round(Number(input.value));
    input.value = String(current);
    if (!Number.isFinite(typed)) {
      this.notice.emit(`BPM is a number from ${TEMPO_MIN} to ${TEMPO_MAX}.`);
      return;
    }

    const bpm = Math.min(TEMPO_MAX, Math.max(TEMPO_MIN, typed));
    if (bpm !== typed) {
      this.notice.emit(`BPM runs from ${TEMPO_MIN} to ${TEMPO_MAX}, so it is set to ${bpm}.`);
      // The song may already be at the bound, and then no new document comes to write the field.
      input.value = String(bpm);
    }
    this.edit.emit(setTempo(bpm));
  }

  /**
   * A meter number picked. **Common time is 4/4 and only 4/4**: a song brought back to 4/4 is then the same as one that
   * never left it, and whether the score draws it as `C` is notation, the composer's to decide, not a control here.
   */
  chooseMeter(part: 'numerator' | 'denominator', select: HTMLSelectElement): void {
    const value = Number(select.value);
    const meter = this.meta?.timeSignature;
    if (meter === undefined) return;
    select.value = String(meter[part]);
    const next = { ...meter, [part]: value };
    this.edit.emit(
      setTimeSignature({
        numerator: next.numerator,
        denominator: next.denominator,
        isCommon: next.numerator === 4 && next.denominator === 4
      })
    );
  }

  toggleNumerals(): void {
    this.preferencesService.setNumerals(!this.preferences.numerals);
  }

  /** `Aa`: the next lyric size, small after large. */
  stepLyricSize(): void {
    this.preferencesService.setLyricSize(this.nextLyricSize);
  }

  toggleSectionMenu(): void {
    this.sectionMenuOpen = !this.sectionMenuOpen;
  }

  /**
   * "+ Section": a section of `kind` after the one holding the caret, named by `newSectionLabelOf`, and the focus in
   * its first line - where the command puts the caret - so the next thing typed is its first words.
   */
  addSection(kind: SectionKind): void {
    this.sectionMenuOpen = false;
    this.edit.emit(addSection(kind, newSectionLabelOf(kind, this.labels)));
    this.sheetFocus.emit();
  }

  /** Escape closes the section menu and gives the focus back to its button. */
  closeSectionMenu(toggle: HTMLElement, event: Event): void {
    if (!this.sectionMenuOpen) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.sectionMenuOpen = false;
    toggle.focus();
  }

  /** A click outside "+ Section" closes its menu, as a menu is expected to. */
  @HostListener('document:click', ['$event'])
  onDocumentClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (!this.sectionMenuOpen) return;
    const target = event.target;
    if (target instanceof Element && target.closest('.add-section') !== null) return;
    this.sectionMenuOpen = false;
    this.changes.markForCheck();
  }

  trackByValue(_index: number, option: TonicOption): string {
    return option.value;
  }

  trackByName(_index: number, group: ScaleGroup): string {
    return group.name;
  }

  private describeScale(): void {
    const scaleId = this.meta?.key.scaleId;
    if (scaleId === undefined) return;
    const listed = this.scaleGroups.some(group => group.scales.some(scale => scale.id === scaleId));
    this.unlistedScale = listed ? null : (this.keys?.findScale(scaleId)?.name ?? scaleId);
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Injectable, InjectionToken, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { BehaviorSubject, Observable } from 'rxjs';

/** The three lyric sizes the sheet's `Aa` steps through. */
export type LyricSize = 'small' | 'medium' | 'large';

/** Every lyric size, in the order `Aa` steps through them. */
export const LYRIC_SIZES: readonly LyricSize[] = Object.freeze(['small', 'medium', 'large']);

/** How this viewer likes the sheet shown. */
export interface SongSheetPreferences {
  /** Roman numerals over the words (`I-IV` pressed) rather than chord names. */
  numerals: boolean;
  lyricSize: LyricSize;
}

const DEFAULTS: SongSheetPreferences = Object.freeze({ numerals: false, lyricSize: 'medium' });

/** One key for both choices, so they are read and written together. */
const STORAGE_KEY = 'songSheetPreferences';

/**
 * Where the preferences are kept: the browser's `localStorage`, or null when the browser will not give it (a sandboxed
 * frame, storage blocked for the site), which reaching for it throws. A token so a spec hands in storage of its own
 * and never leaves a choice behind in the developer's browser.
 */
export const SONG_PREFERENCES_STORAGE = new InjectionToken<Storage | null>('SONG_PREFERENCES_STORAGE', {
  providedIn: 'root',
  factory: () => {
    try {
      return window.localStorage;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
});

/**
 * How the song sheet is shown to this viewer: chord names or Roman numerals (`I-IV`), and the lyric size (`Aa`).
 *
 * **Kept out of the song on purpose.** Both are how one person likes to read a sheet, not what the song is: a
 * co-writer reading in numerals should not turn the other's sheet into numerals, a size change should not be an undo
 * step, and neither should mark the song unsaved or bump its revision. So they live per browser, in `localStorage`,
 * and the document - which design Part 8 keeps for what a future sync would share - never sees them.
 *
 * **A root service rather than storage calls in the page**, so the toolbar that changes them and the page that hands
 * them to the sheet read one source, and the choice holds across every song opened in the visit.
 *
 * **Storage never fails a choice.** Every read and write is guarded: a browser that refuses storage, or is full, keeps
 * the choice for the visit and forgets it on reload, which is the most a preference can lose.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SongSheetPreferencesService {
  private readonly storage = inject(SONG_PREFERENCES_STORAGE);
  private readonly subject = new BehaviorSubject<SongSheetPreferences>(this.read());

  /** The preferences now and on every change; a choice that changes nothing is not published. */
  readonly preferences$: Observable<SongSheetPreferences> = this.subject.asObservable();

  get preferences(): SongSheetPreferences {
    return this.subject.getValue();
  }

  setNumerals(numerals: boolean): void {
    this.update({ ...this.preferences, numerals });
  }

  setLyricSize(lyricSize: LyricSize): void {
    this.update({ ...this.preferences, lyricSize });
  }

  private update(next: SongSheetPreferences): void {
    const current = this.preferences;
    if (next.numerals === current.numerals && next.lyricSize === current.lyricSize) return;
    this.subject.next(next);
    try {
      this.storage?.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    } catch {
      // Full or refused: the choice holds for this visit (see the class comment).
    }
  }

  /** The stored preferences, each one that reads as valid kept and the rest defaulted. */
  private read(): SongSheetPreferences {
    let stored: unknown;
    try {
      stored = JSON.parse(this.storage?.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ?? 'null');
    } catch {
      return DEFAULTS;
    }
    if (typeof stored !== 'object' || stored === null) return DEFAULTS;

    const { numerals, lyricSize } = stored as Record<string, unknown>;
    return {
      numerals: typeof numerals === 'boolean' ? numerals : DEFAULTS.numerals,
      lyricSize: LYRIC_SIZES.includes(lyricSize as LyricSize) ? (lyricSize as LyricSize) : DEFAULTS.lyricSize
    };
  }
}
```

### Task D.3: Place, change, move and remove a chord on the sheet

`[` opens a small field at the caret that reads a name or numeral as you type, shows the chord it would
place, and places it on Enter or a closing `]`. A chord typed in brackets on an empty line is a chord, not a section.
Clicking a chord name opens its popover: change it, set its length in beats or bars, delete it. Dragging a name moves the
chord to another letter, with pointer events, since ProseMirror would otherwise drag the atom itself.

```ts
import { ComponentFixture, TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { ChordDegree, ProgressionKey } from '../../../models/progression.model';
import { SongChordFieldComponent, chordHintOf } from './song-chord-field.component';

const C_MAJOR: ProgressionKey = { tonic: 0, scaleId: 'ionian', preferSharps: true };
const IONIAN = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];

/**
 * The chord field: a text input that reads a chord name or a numeral in the song's key, says what it read as it is
 * typed, and hands the chord on at Enter - or at `]`, so `[Am]` typed in the ChordPro way works through it.
 */
describe('SongChordFieldComponent', () => {
  let fixture: ComponentFixture<SongChordFieldComponent>;
  let field: SongChordFieldComponent;
  let host: HTMLElement;
  let chosen: ChordDegree[];
  let cancelled: number;

  interface Opening {
    initial?: string;
    autofocus?: boolean;
    key?: ProgressionKey;
    scale?: readonly number[] | null;
  }

  function open(inputs: Opening = {}): void {
    fixture = TestBed.createComponent(SongChordFieldComponent);
    field = fixture.componentInstance;
    host = fixture.nativeElement;
    document.body.append(host);
    fixture.componentRef.setInput('key', inputs.key ?? C_MAJOR);
    fixture.componentRef.setInput('scaleIntervals', inputs.scale === undefined ? IONIAN : inputs.scale);
    if (inputs.initial !== undefined) fixture.componentRef.setInput('initial', inputs.initial);
    if (inputs.autofocus !== undefined) fixture.componentRef.setInput('autofocus', inputs.autofocus);
    chosen = [];
    cancelled = 0;
    field.chosen.subscribe(degree => chosen.push(degree));
    field.cancelled.subscribe(() => cancelled++);
    fixture.detectChanges();
  }

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({ imports: [SongChordFieldComponent] }).compileComponents();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    fixture?.destroy();
    host?.remove();
  });

  const input = (): HTMLInputElement => {
    const found = host.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input');
    if (!found) throw new Error('No input');
    return found;
  };
  const hint = (): string => host.querySelector('.chord-field-hint')?.textContent?.trim() ?? '';
  const alerts = (): string => Array.from(host.querySelectorAll('[role="alert"]')).map(el => el.textContent ?? '').join('');

  /** Types `text` as the browser reports it: the value, then an input event carrying what was typed. */
  function type(text: string): void {
    input().value = text;
    input().dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', { data: text.slice(-1), inputType: 'insertText' }));
    fixture.detectChanges();
  }

  function press(key: string): KeyboardEvent {

    input().dispatchEvent(event);

  describe('chordHintOf', () => {
    it('names a chord it reads both ways, name and numeral', () => {
      expect(chordHintOf('Am', C_MAJOR, IONIAN)).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({ kind: 'chord', text: 'Am · vi' }));
      expect(chordHintOf('vi', C_MAJOR, IONIAN)).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({ kind: 'chord', text: 'Am · vi' }));
      expect(chordHintOf('Bb', C_MAJOR, IONIAN)).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({ kind: 'chord', text: 'Bb · ♭VII' }));
      expect(chordHintOf('F/A', C_MAJOR, IONIAN)).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({ kind: 'chord', text: 'F/A · IV' }));
    });

    it('gives the reason for text it cannot read, and a prompt for none', () => {
      expect(chordHintOf('H7', C_MAJOR, IONIAN)).toEqual({
        kind: 'refused',
        text: jasmine.stringMatching(/"H7?" is not a note/)
      });
      expect(chordHintOf('  ', C_MAJOR, IONIAN)).toEqual({ kind: 'empty', text: jasmine.stringMatching(/such as Am/) });
    });
  });

  it('is a labelled text input, described by its hint, and not a combobox', () => {
    open();
    expect(input().type).toBe('text');
    expect(input().getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Chord name or numeral');
    expect(input().getAttribute('role')).toBeNull();
    const described = input().getAttribute('aria-describedby');
    expect(described).toBeTruthy();
    expect(document.getElementById(described ?? '')?.textContent).toContain('such as Am');
  });

  it('shows the chord it would place as it is typed, or why not', () => {
    open();
    type('A');
    expect(hint()).toBe('A · VI');
    type('Am');
    expect(hint()).toBe('Am · vi');
    type('Am/');
    expect(hint()).toMatch(/not a chord type/);
    expect(host.querySelector('.chord-field-hint')?.classList).toContain('is-refused');
  });

  it('hands on the chord at Enter, and takes the key', () => {
    open();
    type('Am');
    const enter = press('Enter');

    expect(enter.defaultPrevented).toBeTrue();
    expect(chosen.length).toBe(1);
    expect(chosen[0]).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({ degree: 5, alter: 0, extent: 3 }));
  });

  it('keeps a refused text, marks it invalid and says why aloud, handing nothing on', () => {
    open();
    type('Xm');
    press('Enter');

    expect(chosen).toEqual([]);
    expect(input().value).toBe('Xm');
    expect(input().getAttribute('aria-invalid')).toBe('true');
    expect(alerts()).toMatch(/"Xm" is not a note/);

    type('Dm');
    expect(input().getAttribute('aria-invalid')).toBe('false');
  });

  it('says a refusal again when Enter is pressed on it again', () => {
    open();
    type('Xm');
    press('Enter');
    const first = Array.from(host.querySelectorAll('[role="alert"]')).map(el => el.textContent);
    press('Enter');
    const second = Array.from(host.querySelectorAll('[role="alert"]')).map(el => el.textContent);
    expect(second).not.toEqual(first);
    expect(alerts()).toMatch(/is not a note/);
  });

  it('treats a closing bracket as Enter, so [Am] typed the ChordPro way places Am', () => {
    open();
    type('Am]');

    expect(chosen.length).toBe(1);
    expect(chosen[0].degree).toBe(5);
    expect(input().value).toBe('Am');
  });

  it('keeps the field open on a refused closing bracket, without the bracket', () => {
    open();
    type('Hm]');

    expect(chosen).toEqual([]);
    expect(input().value).toBe('Hm');
    expect(alerts()).toMatch(/is not a note/);
  });

  it('is cancelled by Escape, which goes no further', () => {
    open();
    const outer = jasmine.createSpy('outer');
    document.addEventListener('keydown', outer);
    type('Am');
    const escape = press('Escape');
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', outer);

    expect(cancelled).toBe(1);
    expect(chosen).toEqual([]);
    expect(escape.defaultPrevented).toBeTrue();
    expect(outer).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('starts from the text it is given, selected, when asked to take the focus', () => {
    open({ initial: 'Am', autofocus: true });

    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(input());
    expect(input().value).toBe('Am');
    expect(input().selectionStart).toBe(0);
    expect(input().selectionEnd).toBe(2);
    expect(hint()).toBe('Am · vi');
  });

  it('starts again from new text when it is given some', () => {
    open({ initial: 'Am' });
    type('Xm');
    fixture.componentRef.setInput('initial', 'F');
    fixture.detectChanges();

    expect(input().value).toBe('F');
    expect(hint()).toBe('F · IV');
  });

  it('refuses every chord in a key that cannot build them', () => {
    open({ scale: null });
    type('Am');
    expect(hint()).toMatch(/can't build chords/);
    press('Enter');
    expect(chosen).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { ComponentFixture, TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { Node } from 'prosemirror-model';
import { EditorState } from 'prosemirror-state';
import type { TimeSignature } from '../../../models/composer.model';
import { createExtensions } from '../../../models/progression-normalize';
import { ChordDegree, ProgressionKey } from '../../../models/progression.model';
import { ChordAtomAttrs } from '../../../models/song.model';
import { MusicTheoryService } from '../../../services/music-theory.service';
import { ProgressionKeyContext } from '../../../services/progression-key-context';
import { SongEdit, chordWithId } from '../../../services/song-commands';
import { chordSlotOf } from '../../../services/song-document';
import { songEditorPlugins } from '../../../services/song-editor-plugins';
import { songSchema } from '../../../services/song-schema';
import { SongChordPopoverComponent } from './song-chord-popover.component';

const C_MAJOR: ProgressionKey = { tonic: 0, scaleId: 'ionian', preferSharps: true };
const IONIAN = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
const FOUR_FOUR: TimeSignature = { numerator: 4, denominator: 4, isCommon: true };
const THREE_FOUR: TimeSignature = { numerator: 3, denominator: 4, isCommon: false };

function degreeAt(degree: number): ChordDegree {
  return {
    degree,
    alter: 0,
    extent: 3,
    quality: null,
    inversion: 0,
    suspension: 'none',
    extensions: createExtensions(),
    octave: 0
  };
}

/** A song of one line, "Wondering", with Am over its W - two beats long, so a change that kept the bar would show. */
function songWith(am: ChordAtomAttrs, timeSignature: TimeSignature = FOUR_FOUR): Node {
  return songSchema.node('doc', { title: '', artist: '', key: C_MAJOR, tempo: 100, timeSignature }, [
    songSchema.node('section', { id: 's1', label: 'Verse 1', kind: 'verse' }, [
      songSchema.node('lyricLine', null, [songSchema.node('chord', am), songSchema.text('Wondering')])
    ])
  ]);
}

/**
 * The chord popover, against a real editor state: each edit it hands out is run on that state, as the page runs it on
 * the sheet, and the document that comes back is given to the popover again - so what it shows after a press is what
 * the song now says.
 */
describe('SongChordPopoverComponent', () => {
  const keys = new ProgressionKeyContext(new MusicTheoryService());
  let fixture: ComponentFixture<SongChordPopoverComponent>;
  let popover: SongChordPopoverComponent;
  let host: HTMLElement;
  let state: EditorState;
  let closed: boolean[];
  let id: string;

  function open(timeSignature: TimeSignature = FOUR_FOUR): void {
    const am = { ...chordSlotOf(degreeAt(5), C_MAJOR, IONIAN, timeSignature), lengthBeats: 2 };
    id = am.id;
    state = EditorState.create({ doc: songWith(am, timeSignature), plugins: songEditorPlugins() });

    fixture = TestBed.createComponent(SongChordPopoverComponent);
    popover = fixture.componentInstance;
    host = fixture.nativeElement;
    document.body.append(host);
    fixture.componentRef.setInput('doc', state.doc);
    fixture.componentRef.setInput('chordId', id);
    fixture.componentRef.setInput('keys', keys);
    closed = [];
    popover.closed.subscribe(giveBack => closed.push(giveBack));
    popover.edit.subscribe((edit: SongEdit) => {
      const outcome = edit(state);
      if (outcome.kind !== 'edit') return;
      state = state.apply(outcome.tr);
      fixture.componentRef.setInput('doc', state.doc);
    });
    fixture.detectChanges();
  }

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({ imports: [SongChordPopoverComponent] }).compileComponents();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    fixture?.destroy();
    host?.remove();
  });

  function element<T extends HTMLElement>(selector: string): T {
    const found = host.querySelector<T>(selector);
    if (!found) throw new Error(`No ${selector} in the popover`);
    return found;
  }

  function press(selector: string): void {
    element<HTMLButtonElement>(selector).click();
    fixture.detectChanges();
  }

  const chordNow = (): ChordAtomAttrs | null => chordWithId(state.doc, id)?.attrs ?? null;
  const presets = (): HTMLButtonElement[] => Array.from(host.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('.length-preset'));

  function typeChord(text: string): void {
    const input = element<HTMLInputElement>('.chord-field-input');
    input.value = text;
    input.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', { data: text.slice(-1), inputType: 'insertText' }));
    input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
    fixture.detectChanges();
  }

  it('is a labelled, non-modal dialog that opens with the focus on its chord, written as the sheet writes it', () => {
    open();
    const dialog = element('[role="dialog"]');
    expect(dialog.getAttribute('aria-modal')).toBeNull();
    const title = document.getElementById(dialog.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') ?? '');
    expect(title?.textContent?.trim()).toBe('Am · vi');

    const input = element<HTMLInputElement>('.chord-field-input');
    expect(input.value).toBe('Am');
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(input);
  });

  describe('the chord', () => {
    it('changes to what is typed, keeping the chord\'s id and its length', () => {
      open();
      typeChord('F');

      const after = chordNow();
      expect(after?.id).toBe(id);
      expect(after?.lengthBeats).toBe(2);
      expect(after?.harmony).toEqual({ kind: 'degree', degree: degreeAt(3) });
      expect(element('.chord-popover-title').textContent?.trim()).toBe('F · IV');
      expect(element<HTMLInputElement>('.chord-field-input').value).toBe('F');
    });

    it('re-voices the chord it changes to', () => {
      open();
      typeChord('F');
      const pitchClasses = [...new Set(chordNow()?.notes.map(note => note.midi % 12))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      expect(pitchClasses).toEqual([0, 5, 9]);
    });

    it('changes nothing for text it cannot read, and stays open saying why', () => {
      open();
      const before = state.doc;
      typeChord('Q');
      expect(state.doc).toBe(before);
      expect(closed).toEqual([]);
      expect(host.textContent).toMatch(/"Q" is not a note/);
    });
  });

  describe('the length', () => {
    it('steps a beat at a time, and shows the length in beats', () => {
      open();
      expect(element('.length-value').textContent?.trim()).toBe('2 beats');

      press('.length-longer');
      expect(chordNow()?.lengthBeats).toBe(3);
      press('.length-shorter');
      press('.length-shorter');
      expect(chordNow()?.lengthBeats).toBe(1);
      expect(element('.length-value').textContent?.trim()).toBe('1 beat');
    });

    it('dims the shorter step at the shortest a chord can be, and a press there changes nothing', () => {
      open();
      press('.length-shorter');
      expect(element('.length-shorter').getAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe('true');
      const before = state.doc;
      press('.length-shorter');
      expect(state.doc).toBe(before);
    });

    it('offers half a bar, a bar and two bars of the song\'s meter, marking the one it is', () => {
      open();
      expect(presets().map(button => button.textContent?.trim())).toEqual(['½ bar', '1 bar', '2 bars']);
      expect(presets().map(button => button.getAttribute('aria-pressed'))).toEqual(['true', 'false', 'false']);

      presets()[2].click();
      fixture.detectChanges();
      expect(chordNow()?.lengthBeats).toBe(8);
      expect(presets().map(button => button.getAttribute('aria-pressed'))).toEqual(['false', 'false', 'true']);
    });

    it('works the bars out from the meter: a bar of 3/4 is three beats', () => {
      open(THREE_FOUR);
      presets()[0].click();
      fixture.detectChanges();
      expect(chordNow()?.lengthBeats).toBe(1.5);
      expect(element('.length-value').textContent?.trim()).toBe('1.5 beats');

      press('.length-longer');
      expect(chordNow()?.lengthBeats).toBe(2);
      presets()[1].click();
      expect(chordNow()?.lengthBeats).toBe(3);
    });
  });

  it('deletes the chord and closes, giving the focus back', () => {
    open();
    press('.delete-chord');

    expect(chordNow()).toBeNull();
    expect(closed).toEqual([true]);
  });

  describe('closing', () => {
    it('closes on Escape, giving the focus back', () => {
      open();
      element('.chord-popover-length').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true }));
      expect(closed).toEqual([true]);
    });

    it('closes on Escape in its chord field too, once', () => {
      open();
      element('.chord-field-input').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true }));
      expect(closed).toEqual([true]);
    });

    it('closes on a press outside it, leaving the focus where the press put it', () => {
      open();
      element('.length-longer').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true }));
      expect(closed).toEqual([]);

      document.body.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true }));
      expect(closed).toEqual([false]);
```

```ts
  });

  describe('chords on the sheet', () => {
    const sheet = (): SongSheetComponent => {
      const found = harness.fixture.debugElement.query(By.directive(SongSheetComponent));
      if (!found) throw new Error('No sheet on the page');
      return found.componentInstance;
    };
    const editorState = (): EditorState => {
      const state = sheet().editorState();
      if (!state) throw new Error('No editor');
      return state;
    };
    const editor = (): HTMLElement => element('.ProseMirror');
    const field = (): HTMLInputElement | null => host().querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('.chord-field-anchor input');
    /** Lets ProseMirror's DOM observer read a change the browser made, which it does on a mutation callback. */
    const settled = (): Promise<void> => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 20));

    /** Puts the caret at `pos` in the lyrics and presses `[` there, as the browser types it. */
    async function bracketAt(pos: number): Promise<void> {
      sheet().focus();
      const state = editorState();
      sheet().run(() => ({ kind: 'edit', tr: state.tr.setSelection(TextSelection.create(state.doc, pos)) }));
      document.execCommand('insertText', false, '[');
      await settled();
      harness.detectChanges();
    }

    function typeInField(text: string): void {
      const input = field();
      if (!input) throw new Error('No chord field');
      input.value = text;
      input.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', { data: text.slice(-1), inputType: 'insertText' }));
      harness.detectChanges();
    }

    function keyIn(target: HTMLElement, key: string, modifiers: { altKey?: boolean } = {}): void {
      target.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, ...modifiers }));
      harness.detectChanges();
    }

    // "Last Dance": the section opens at 0, its line at 1, C at 2, "Got me " from 3, Am at 10, "thinking" from 11.

      expect(editorState().doc.textContent).toBe('Got me thinking');

      typeInField('F');
      expect(text('.chord-field-anchor .chord-field-hint')).toBe('F · IV');
      keyIn(field() ?? editor(), 'Enter');

      expect(field()).toBeNull();
      expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'F', 'Am']);
      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(editor());
      expect(editorState().selection.from).toBe(8);

      sheet().undo();
      harness.detectChanges();
      expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'Am']);
    });

    it('opens a fresh field for a chord typed straight after one is placed, before the page draws again', async () => {
      const song = await storeSong();

      // Enter, and the next `[` at once: no change detection of the spec's own in between, as fast typing allows none.

      expect(field()?.value).toBe('');

      expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'F', 'Am', 'G']);
    });
```

```ts
  describe('dragging a chord', () => {
    /** A pointer event as a mouse with its button held makes it. */
    function pointer(type: string, target: Element, x: number, y: number): void {
      target.dispatchEvent(
        new PointerEvent(type, {
          pointerId: 1,
          pointerType: 'mouse',
          isPrimary: true,
          button: 0,
          buttons: type === 'pointerup' ? 0 : 1,
          clientX: x,
          clientY: y,
          bubbles: true,
          cancelable: true
        })
      );
    }

    /** Presses the name, moves it by (dx, dy) in two steps, and checks the drop caret on the way; then lets go. */
    function drag(name: HTMLElement, dx: number, dy: number, whileDragging: () => void = () => undefined): void {
      const home = name.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = home.left + 2;
      const y = home.top + 2;
      pointer('pointerdown', name, x, y);
      pointer('pointermove', name, x + dx / 2, y + dy / 2);
      pointer('pointermove', name, x + dx, y + dy);
      whileDragging();
      pointer('pointerup', name, x + dx, y + dy);
    }

    /** The box of the character at `index` in the first text of the sheet containing `text`. */
    function letterIn(text: string, index: number): DOMRect {
      const walker = document.createTreeWalker(editor(), NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
      for (let node = walker.nextNode(); node; node = walker.nextNode()) {
        const at = (node.textContent ?? '').indexOf(text);
        if (at < 0) continue;
        const range = document.createRange();
        range.setStart(node, at + index);
        range.setEnd(node, at + index + 1);
        return range.getBoundingClientRect();
      }
      throw new Error(`No "${text}" on the sheet`);
    }

    it('moves a chord dropped over another letter there, keeping its id and length, and selects it', () => {
      const am = chord(5);
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1', line(am, 'Wondering where the'))));
      const name = nameOf(chordEls()[0]);
      const target = letterIn('where', 0);

      drag(name, target.left - name.getBoundingClientRect().left, 0, () => {
        const caret = host.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.song-drop-caret');
        expect(caret?.hidden).toBeFalse();
        expect(Math.abs((caret?.getBoundingClientRect().left ?? -99) - target.left)).toBeLessThan(2);
      });

      expect(linesOf(current())).toEqual(['Wondering *where the']);
      const selection = sheet.editorState()?.selection;
      expect(selection instanceof NodeSelection && selection.node.attrs['id']).toBe(am.attrs['id']);
      expect(host.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.song-drop-caret')?.hidden).toBeTrue();
      expect(changed.length).toBe(1);
      expect(opened).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('moves a chord to a letter on another line', () => {
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1', line(chord(5), 'Wondering'), line('where the'))));
      const name = nameOf(chordEls()[0]);
      const home = name.getBoundingClientRect();
      const target = letterIn('the', 0);

      drag(name, target.left - home.left, target.top - letterIn('Wondering', 0).top);

      expect(linesOf(current())).toEqual(['Wondering', 'where *the']);
    });

    it('refuses a drop outside the lines of lyrics, saying why, and leaves the chord where it was', () => {
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1', line(chord(5), 'Wondering'))));
      const before = current();

      drag(nameOf(chordEls()[0]), 0, -2000);

      expect(current()).toBe(before);
      expect(refusals).toEqual(['A chord can only be dropped onto a line of lyrics.']);
      expect(host.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.song-drop-caret')?.hidden).toBeTrue();
    });

    it('takes a press that hardly moves for a click, which opens the chord', () => {
      const am = chord(5);
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1', line(am, 'Wondering'))));
      const name = nameOf(chordEls()[0]);

    it('does not open the chord on the click that ends a drag', () => {
      open(song(section('v1', 'Verse 1', line(chord(5), 'Wondering where'))));

      expect(start.defaultPrevented).toBeTrue();
```

```ts
    it('writes the new degree over the chord, keeping its id, its place and its length', () => {
      const after = run(stateOf(doc), changeChord(keys, id, degreeAt(3)));

      expect(sheetOf(after.doc)).toEqual(['Wondering [3]where']);
      const changed = onlyChord(after.doc);
      expect(changed.id).toBe(id);
      expect(changed.lengthBeats).toBe(2);
      expect(changed.harmony).toEqual({ kind: 'degree', degree: degreeAt(3) });
    });

    it('voices the new chord, handing back pitches the slot owned and keeping the rhythm it owned', () => {
      const changed = onlyChord(run(stateOf(doc), changeChord(keys, id, degreeAt(3))).doc);

      // F major: F, A, C - the user's C# went with the chord they replaced.
      expect(pitchClassesOf(changed)).toEqual([0, 5, 9]);
      expect(changed.owned).toEqual({ pitches: false, timing: true, velocity: false });
      expect(changed.notes.every(note => note.startBeat === 0.5 && note.lengthBeats === 1)).toBeTrue();
    });

    it('changes nothing when the degree is the one the chord has, owned pitches and all', () => {
      expect(changeChord(keys, id, degreeAt(5))(stateOf(doc)).kind).toBe('unchanged');
      expect(changeChord(keys, plain.attrs['id'], degreeAt(5))(stateOf(plainDoc)).kind).toBe('unchanged');
    });

    it('refuses a chord that is not in the song, and a key that cannot build chords', () => {
      expect(reasonOf(stateOf(doc), changeChord(keys, 'gone', degreeAt(3)))).toMatch(/no longer in the song/);
      const pentatonic = songSchema.node('doc', { ...META, key: { ...C_MAJOR, scaleId: 'majorPentatonic' } }, [
        section('s1', 'Verse 1', line(plain, 'Wondering'))
      ]);
      expect(reasonOf(stateOf(pentatonic), changeChord(keys, plain.attrs['id'], degreeAt(3)))).toMatch(
        /can't build chords/
      );
    });

    it('is one undo step', () => {
      expectOneUndoStep(stateOf(plainDoc), changeChord(keys, plain.attrs['id'], degreeAt(0)));
    });
  });
```

<!-- apply: create client/src/app/components/songs/song-chord-field/song-chord-field.component.ts -->
```ts
import {
  AfterViewInit,
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  Output,
  SimpleChanges,
  ViewChild
} from '@angular/core';
import type { ChordDegree, ProgressionKey } from '../../../models/progression.model';
import { chordFromText } from '../../../services/song-chord-parse';
import { leadSheetNameOf, numeralOf } from '../../../services/song-chord-names';

/** What the field says under itself about the text in it. */
export interface ChordHint {
  /** `empty`: nothing typed yet, a prompt. `chord`: what Enter would place. `refused`: why Enter would not. */
  kind: 'empty' | 'chord' | 'refused';
  text: string;
}

/**
 * What the field says about `text` in `key`: the chord it reads, by both of the sheet's names for it - `Am · vi` -
 * or the parser's reason for reading none, or the parser's prompt when there is nothing to read.
 *
 * Both names, because the field takes either and a songwriter thinks in one or the other: typing `vi` and seeing
 * `Am` confirms the key is the one they think it is, and typing `Bb` in C and seeing `♭VII` says how the sheet will
 * file it - and transpose it.
 */
export function chordHintOf(text: string, key: ProgressionKey, scaleIntervals: readonly number[] | null): ChordHint {
  const reading = chordFromText(text, key, scaleIntervals);
  if (reading.kind === 'refused') return { kind: text.trim() === '' ? 'empty' : 'refused', text: reading.reason };
  // `chordFromText` reads a chord only in a key whose scale can build them, so this is a broken promise, not a case.
  if (scaleIntervals === null) throw new Error('A chord was read in a key with no chord scale');
  return {
    kind: 'chord',
    text: `${leadSheetNameOf(reading.degree, key, scaleIntervals)} · ${numeralOf(reading.degree, scaleIntervals)}`
  };
}

/** Gives each field's hint a distinct id for `aria-describedby`. */
let fieldCount = 0;

/**
 * The chord field: a text box that takes a chord by name or numeral - `Am`, `vi`, `Bb7`, `F/A` - in the song's key
 * (design Part 2), says under itself what it would place, and hands the chord on as a degree.
 *
 * It is used in two places, and owns neither's placement: the field `[` opens over the lyrics (the song page anchors
 * it at the caret, and places what it hands on), and the Chord row of a chord's popover (which changes the chord to
 * it). Both want the same reading, the same hint and the same keys, so they share this.
 *
 * **The keys.** Enter hands the chord on - or, for text it cannot read, keeps the text, marks the field invalid and
 * says the reason aloud. A `]` typed at the end does what Enter does, so `[Am]` typed in one go, the ChordPro way,
 * places Am wherever `[` opened the field (see `song-editor-plugins.ts`). Escape cancels, and goes no further: the
 * page's own Escape (the nav drawer's) must not fire as well.
 *
 * **Accessibility.** A plain labelled text input - not a combobox: it offers no list to pick from - described by its
 * hint, so the hint is read when the field takes the focus. The hint changes on every keystroke and is not itself
 * live, which would chatter; a refusal at Enter is said once through an alert, in two halves that swap so the same
 * reason said twice is still a change (`SongEditorComponent.messages`'s pattern).
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-song-chord-field',
  standalone: true,
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  templateUrl: './song-chord-field.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./song-chord-field.component.scss']
})
export class SongChordFieldComponent implements OnChanges, AfterViewInit {
  /** The song's key, which the text is read in. */
  @Input() key: ProgressionKey | null = null;
  /** The key's scale when it can build chords, else null - and then every chord is refused, with the reason. */
  @Input() scaleIntervals: readonly number[] | null = null;
  /** The text the field starts from - the chord's own name in a popover - and starts again from when it changes. */
  @Input() initial = '';
  @Input() label = 'Chord name or numeral';
  /** Take the focus on opening, with the starting text selected so typing replaces it. */
  @Input() autofocus = false;

  /** A chord read from the text, at Enter or a closing `]`. */
  @Output() readonly chosen = new EventEmitter<ChordDegree>();
  /** Escape. */
  @Output() readonly cancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();

  @ViewChild('input', { static: true }) private input?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  readonly hintId = `song-chord-hint-${++fieldCount}`;
  text = '';
  hint: ChordHint = { kind: 'empty', text: '' };
  /** Set by a refused Enter, cleared by the next edit: `aria-invalid` says the text is the problem, not the key. */
  invalid = false;
  /** The alert's two halves (see the class comment). */
  alerts: readonly [string, string] = ['', ''];

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['initial']) {
      this.text = this.initial;
      this.invalid = false;
    }
    this.hint = this.hintFor(this.text);
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    const input = this.input?.nativeElement;
    if (!this.autofocus || input === undefined) return;
    input.focus();
    input.select();
  }

  /** Every edit: the hint follows the text, and a `]` at the end commits it. */
  onInput(input: HTMLInputElement): void {
    this.invalid = false;
    if (input.value.endsWith(']')) {
      input.value = input.value.slice(0, -1);
      this.read(input.value);
      this.commit();
      return;
    }
    this.read(input.value);
  }

  onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.commit();
    } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      this.cancelled.emit();
    }
  }

  private read(text: string): void {
    this.text = text;
    this.hint = this.hintFor(text);
  }

  /** Hands the chord on, or keeps the field open and says why not. */
  private commit(): void {
    const key = this.key;
    const reading = key === null ? null : chordFromText(this.text, key, this.scaleIntervals);
    if (reading?.kind === 'chord') {
      this.invalid = false;
      this.chosen.emit(reading.degree);
      return;
    }
    this.invalid = true;
    const reason = reading?.reason ?? this.hint.text;
    this.alerts = this.alerts[0] === '' ? [reason, ''] : ['', reason];
  }

  private hintFor(text: string): ChordHint {
    return this.key === null ? { kind: 'empty', text: '' } : chordHintOf(text, this.key, this.scaleIntervals);
  }
}
```

```html
<div *ngIf="model as model" #dialog class="chord-popover" role="dialog" [attr.aria-labelledby]="titleId">
  <p class="chord-popover-title" [id]="titleId">{{ model.title }}</p>

    <span class="row-label" aria-hidden="true">Chord</span>
    <app-song-chord-field
      label="Chord"
      [key]="model.key"
      [scaleIntervals]="model.scaleIntervals"
      [initial]="model.name"
      [autofocus]="true"
      (chosen)="changeChord($event)"
      (cancelled)="cancel()"
    ></app-song-chord-field>
  </div>

  <div class="chord-popover-row chord-popover-length" role="group" aria-label="Length">
    <span class="row-label" aria-hidden="true">Length</span>
    <div class="stepper">
      <!-- Dimmed, not disabled, at the shortest: a press there changes nothing, and the button keeps its place in Tab. -->
      <button
        type="button"
        class="tool length-shorter"
        aria-label="A beat shorter"
        [attr.aria-disabled]="atShortest()"
        (click)="step(-1)"
      >
        −
      </button>
      <span class="length-value">{{ model.lengthText }}</span>
      <button type="button" class="tool length-longer" aria-label="A beat longer" (click)="step(1)">+</button>
    </div>
    <div class="presets">
      <button
        *ngFor="let preset of model.presets; trackBy: trackByLabel"
        type="button"
        class="tool length-preset"
        [class.on]="preset.beats === model.lengthBeats"
        [attr.aria-pressed]="preset.beats === model.lengthBeats"
        (click)="setLength(preset.beats)"
      >
        {{ preset.label }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="chord-popover-row chord-popover-actions">
    <button type="button" class="tool delete-chord" (click)="remove()">Delete chord</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

```scss
// The song pages' tokens, each with its own value as the fallback so the popover renders the same outside the page.
// Its panel is the menus' (`.song-section-menu`): the bar colour, a border, a shadow, over everything on the sheet.
:host {
  --popover-panel: var(--songs-bar, #2c3e50);
  --popover-border: var(--songs-border, #465666);
  --popover-text: var(--songs-text, #ecf0f1);
  --popover-text-dim: var(--songs-text-dim, #adbcc8);
  --popover-accent: var(--songs-accent, #3498db);
  --popover-error: var(--songs-error, #f1948a);

  display: block;
}

.chord-popover {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  width: 17rem;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  background-color: var(--popover-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--popover-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 40%);
  color: var(--popover-text);
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.chord-popover-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.chord-popover-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 3.75rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: start;
  gap: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
}

.row-label {
  padding-top: 0.35rem;
  color: var(--popover-text-dim);
}

.stepper,
.presets {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
}

// The presets sit under the stepper, in the value column.
.presets {
  grid-column: 2;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.length-value {
  min-width: 4.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.chord-popover-actions {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  justify-items: end;
}

// The flat tool style: no chrome until hovered, colour only on the preset the chord is now.
.tool {
  padding: 0.25rem 0.55rem;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--popover-text);
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 90ms ease-out;

  &:hover:not(.on) {
    background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 10%);
  }

  &:active {
    background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 16%);
  }

  &.on {
    background-color: var(--popover-accent);
    color: #fff;
  }

  &[aria-disabled='true'] {
    opacity: 0.42;
    cursor: not-allowed;
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--popover-text);
    outline-offset: -2px;
  }
}

.delete-chord {
  color: var(--popover-error);
}
```
