```ts
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { By } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { provideRouter } from '@angular/router';
import { RouterTestingHarness } from '@angular/router/testing';
import { Node } from 'prosemirror-model';
import { EditorState, TextSelection } from 'prosemirror-state';
import { createExtensions } from '../../../models/progression-normalize';
import { ChordDegree, ProgressionKey, RollNote } from '../../../models/progression.model';
import { ChordAtomAttrs, SongDoc } from '../../../models/song.model';
import { deletedDatabase } from '../../../services/indexed-db.spec-helper';
import { ProgressionPlayerService } from '../../../services/progression-player.service';
import { AutosaveClock } from '../../../services/song-autosave';
import { chordSlotOf } from '../../../services/song-document';
import { SONG_LIBRARY_DB, SongLibraryService } from '../../../services/song-library.service';
import { songSchema } from '../../../services/song-schema';
import { SONG_PREFERENCES_STORAGE, SongSheetPreferencesService } from '../../../services/song-sheet-preferences.service';
import { SongSheetComponent } from '../song-sheet/song-sheet.component';
import { SONG_AUTOSAVE_CLOCK, SongEditorComponent } from './song-editor.component';

const C_MAJOR: ProgressionKey = { tonic: 0, scaleId: 'ionian', preferSharps: true };
const IONIAN = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
const FOUR_FOUR = { numerator: 4, denominator: 4, isCommon: true };

function chord(degree: number): Node {
  const at: ChordDegree = {
    degree,
    alter: 0,
    extent: 3,
    quality: null,
    inversion: 0,
    suspension: 'none',
    extensions: createExtensions(),
    octave: 0
  };
  return songSchema.node('chord', chordSlotOf(at, C_MAJOR, IONIAN, FOUR_FOUR));
}

/** "Last Dance" in C major at 100 BPM: C over "Got" and Am over "thinking". */
function lastDance(): Node {
  return songSchema.node(
    'doc',
    { title: 'Last Dance', artist: 'The Band', key: C_MAJOR, tempo: 100, timeSignature: FOUR_FOUR },
    [
      songSchema.node('section', { id: crypto.randomUUID(), label: 'Verse 1', kind: 'verse' }, [
        songSchema.node('lyricLine', null, [chord(0), songSchema.text('Got me '), chord(5), songSchema.text('thinking')])
      ])
    ]
  );
}

/** A clock whose timers never come due: nothing autosaves behind a spec's back. */
class StoppedClock implements AutosaveClock {
  now(): number {
    return Date.now();
  }
  setTimeout(): unknown {
    return 0;
  }
  clearTimeout(): void {
    return;
  }
}

/** One audition asked of the player. */
interface Audition {
  notes: readonly RollNote[];
  seconds: number;
  tempo: number;
}

/**
 * The player, as far as the song page uses it: it records each audition, and fails one with `failure` as a browser
 * that will not start audio does. No Tone, so nothing here touches the headless browser's audio context.
 */
class FakePlayer implements Pick<ProgressionPlayerService, 'audition'> {
  readonly auditions: Audition[] = [];
  failure: Error | null = null;

  audition(notes: readonly RollNote[], seconds: number, tempo: number): Promise<void> {
    this.auditions.push({ notes, seconds, tempo });
    return this.failure === null ? Promise.resolve() : Promise.reject(this.failure);
  }
}

@Component({ standalone: true, template: '<p class="library-stand-in">Library</p>' })
class LibraryStandIn {}

/**
 * Hearing a chord on the song page: a chord the Chords tab places sounds as it lands (unless the viewer has turned
 * that off), the popover's Hear it plays its chord, and a click on a chord's name - which is for editing - is silent.
 * Against real routing and a song library of its own in real IndexedDB, with the player faked.
 */
describe('SongEditorComponent: hearing chords', () => {
  let harness: RouterTestingHarness;
  let library: SongLibraryService;
  let player: FakePlayer;
  let dbName: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    dbName = `song-editor-audition-spec-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
    player = new FakePlayer();
    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      providers: [
        provideRouter([
          { path: 'songs/:id', component: SongEditorComponent },
          { path: 'songs', component: LibraryStandIn }
        ]),
        { provide: SONG_LIBRARY_DB, useValue: dbName },
        { provide: SONG_AUTOSAVE_CLOCK, useValue: new StoppedClock() },
        { provide: SONG_PREFERENCES_STORAGE, useValue: null }
      ]
    })
      .overrideComponent(SongEditorComponent, {
        set: { providers: [{ provide: ProgressionPlayerService, useValue: player }] }
      })
      .compileComponents();
    library = TestBed.inject(SongLibraryService);
    harness = await RouterTestingHarness.create();
  });

  afterEach(async () => {
    harness.fixture.destroy();
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    await deletedDatabase(dbName);
  });

  const host = (): HTMLElement => harness.fixture.nativeElement;
  const text = (selector: string): string => host().querySelector(selector)?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() ?? '';
  const messages = (): string => text('.editor-messages');
  const names = (): string[] => Array.from(host().querySelectorAll('.song-chord-name')).map(name => name.textContent ?? '');

  function element<T extends HTMLElement>(selector: string): T {
    const found = host().querySelector<T>(selector);
    if (!found) throw new Error(`No ${selector} on the page`);
    return found;
  }

  async function until(done: () => boolean): Promise<void> {
    for (let waited = 0; waited < 2000; waited += 10) {
      harness.detectChanges();
      if (done()) return;
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
    }
    harness.detectChanges();
  }

  async function openLastDance(): Promise<void> {
    const created = await library.createSong();
    const song: SongDoc = await library.saveSong({ ...created, content: lastDance().toJSON() });
    await harness.navigateByUrl(`/songs/${song.id}`, SongEditorComponent);
    await until(() => host().querySelector('.ProseMirror') !== null);
  }

  const sheet = (): SongSheetComponent => {
    const found = harness.fixture.debugElement.query(By.directive(SongSheetComponent));
    if (!found) throw new Error('No sheet on the page');
    return found.componentInstance;
  };
  const editorState = (): EditorState => {
    const state = sheet().editorState();
    if (!state) throw new Error('No editor');
    return state;
  };

  /** The song's chords now, in order, as the sheet holds them. */
  function chords(): ChordAtomAttrs[] {
    const found: ChordAtomAttrs[] = [];
    editorState().doc.descendants(node => {
      if (node.type.name === 'chord') found.push(node.attrs as ChordAtomAttrs);
    });
    return found;
  }

  function cell(group: string, index: number): HTMLButtonElement {
    const found = host().querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-group="${group}"] .cell`).item(index);
    if (!found) throw new Error(`No cell ${index} in ${group}`);
    return found;
  }

  function press(target: HTMLElement): void {
    target.click();
    harness.detectChanges();
  }

  /** The caret at `pos` in the lyrics, and then the focus elsewhere, as a click away does. */
  function caretAt(pos: number): void {
    sheet().focus();
    sheet().run(state => ({ kind: 'edit', tr: state.tr.setSelection(TextSelection.create(state.doc, pos)) }));
    element<HTMLInputElement>('.song-title').focus();
    harness.detectChanges();
  }

  const chordName = (index: number): HTMLElement => host().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.song-chord-name')[index];

  // "Last Dance": the section opens at 0, its line at 1, C at 2, "Got me " from 3, Am at 10, "thinking" from 11.

  describe('placing from the Chords tab', () => {
    it('plays the chord it places, voiced as it was placed, at the song\'s tempo, as a short stab', async () => {
      await openLastDance();
      caretAt(7);

      press(cell('triads', 3));

      expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'F', 'Am']);
      const placed = chords()[1];
      expect(player.auditions).toEqual([{ notes: placed.notes, seconds: 1.5, tempo: 100 }]);
      expect(placed.notes.length).toBe(3);
    });

    it('plays the new chord when a click replaces the one selected on the sheet', async () => {
      await openLastDance();
      press(chordName(1));

      press(cell('triads', 1));

      expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'Dm']);
      expect(player.auditions.map(audition => audition.notes)).toEqual([chords()[1].notes]);
    });

    it('plays nothing when nothing was placed', async () => {
      await openLastDance();

      press(cell('triads', 3));

      expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'Am']);
      expect(player.auditions).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('places silently once the viewer has turned the sound off, and remembers that', async () => {
      await openLastDance();
      const toggle = element<HTMLButtonElement>('.panel-sound');
      expect(toggle.getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('true');

      press(toggle);
      expect(toggle.getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('false');
      expect(TestBed.inject(SongSheetPreferencesService).preferences.playOnPlace).toBeFalse();

      caretAt(7);
      press(cell('triads', 3));
      expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'F', 'Am']);
      expect(player.auditions).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  describe('the popover', () => {
    it('plays its chord on Hear it, with the sound on or off', async () => {
      await openLastDance();
      press(element('.panel-sound'));
      press(chordName(1));

      press(element('.hear-chord'));

      expect(player.auditions).toEqual([{ notes: chords()[1].notes, seconds: 1.5, tempo: 100 }]);
      expect(host().querySelector('app-song-chord-popover [role="dialog"]')).not.toBeNull();
    });
  });

  it('opens a chord whose name is clicked without playing it', async () => {
    await openLastDance();

    press(chordName(0));

    expect(host().querySelector('app-song-chord-popover [role="dialog"]')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(player.auditions).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('says in the live region why there was no sound, and tries again on the next click', async () => {
    await openLastDance();
    caretAt(7);
    player.failure = new Error('The AudioContext was not allowed to start');

    press(cell('triads', 3));
    await until(() => messages() !== '');

    expect(messages()).toBe('Sound could not start: The AudioContext was not allowed to start');
    expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'F', 'Am']);

    player.failure = null;
    caretAt(8);
    press(cell('triads', 4));
    expect(player.auditions.length).toBe(2);
  });
});
```

```ts
    });
  });

  /**
   * One chord, heard now: what the song page plays when a chord is placed or asked for.
   *
   * Straight onto the synth at the audio clock's `now()`, never through the transport - the transport is the
   * progression's, and a chord heard in passing has no business starting, stopping or rescheduling it.
   */
  describe('audition', () => {
    /** C major as a slot voices it at `mf`: a bar long. */
    const cMajor = (): RollNote[] => [note(60, 0, 4), note(64, 0, 4), note(67, 0, 4)];

    it('strikes every note together, now, in hertz and as a gain', async () => {
      audio.clock = 12.5;

      // The last note starts half a beat into its slot - a hand-voiced roll can do that - and is struck with the
      // rest anyway: an audition is a chord stab, not a replay of the slot's rhythm.
      await player.audition([note(69, 0, 4, 127), note(60, 0, 4, 80), note(64, 0.5, 4, 40)], 1.5, 120);

      const triggered = audio.synth.triggered;
      expect(triggered.map(call => call.time)).toEqual([12.5, 12.5, 12.5]);
      expect(triggered[0].frequency).toBeCloseTo(440, 9);
      expect(triggered[1].frequency).toBeCloseTo(261.6255653, 6);
      expect(triggered.map(call => call.velocity)).toEqual([1, 80 / 127, 40 / 127]);
    });

    it('holds each note for its own length at the tempo, and no longer than the audition', async () => {
      // At 120 BPM a beat is half a second: one beat is 0.5 s and sounds whole; four beats are 2 s and stop at 1.5.
      await player.audition([note(60, 0, 1), note(64, 0, 4)], 1.5, 120);

      expect(audio.synth.triggered.map(call => call.duration)).toEqual([0.5, 1.5]);
    });

    it('resumes the audio context first, inside the gesture, and strikes nothing until it has', async () => {
      audio.gateResume = true;

      const heard = player.audition(cMajor(), 1.5, 120);
      expect(audio.resumeCalls).toBe(1);
      await Promise.resolve();
      expect(audio.synth.triggered).toEqual([]);

      audio.openResumeGate();
      await heard;
      expect(audio.synth.triggered.length).toBe(3);
    });

    it('leaves the transport alone', async () => {
      await player.audition(cMajor(), 1.5, 120);

      const transport = audio.transportStub;
      expect(transport.starts).toBe(0);
      expect(transport.stops).toBe(0);
      expect(transport.cancels).toBe(0);
      expect(transport.tempo).toBeNull();
      expect(audio.parts).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('leaves a progression that is playing alone, sounding over it', async () => {
      await player.play(twoChords());
      const parts = audio.livingParts;
      const releasesBefore = audio.synth.releases;

      await player.audition(cMajor(), 1.5, 120);

      // Not stopped, not cancelled, and no `releaseAll` - which would cut the progression's sounding chord too.
      expect(audio.transportStub.stops).toBe(0);
      expect(audio.transportStub.cancels).toBe(0);
      expect(audio.synth.releases).toBe(releasesBefore);
      expect(audio.livingParts).toEqual(parts);
      cuePart().fire(1);
      expect(currentSlot()).toBe('b');

      // And the play is still the one a stop stops.
      player.stop();
      expect(audio.transportStub.stops).toBe(1);
    });

    it('lets the chord before it go when another is asked for, so a run of clicks does not pile up', async () => {
      await player.audition(cMajor(), 1.5, 120);
      let struckWhenReleased = -1;
      spyOn(audio.synth, 'releaseAll').and.callFake(() => {
        struckWhenReleased = audio.synth.triggered.length;
      });

      await player.audition([note(57, 0, 4), note(60, 0, 4), note(64, 0, 4)], 1.5, 120);

      // Released once, after the first chord's three notes and before the second's.
      expect(audio.synth.releaseAll).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(struckWhenReleased).toBe(3);
      expect(audio.synth.triggered.length).toBe(6);
    });

    it('sounds only the newest of two auditions still waiting on the context', async () => {
      audio.gateResume = true;

      const first = player.audition(cMajor(), 1.5, 120);
      const second = player.audition([note(57, 0, 4)], 1.5, 120);
      audio.openResumeGate();
      await Promise.all([first, second]);

      expect(audio.synth.triggered.length).toBe(1);
      expect(audio.synth.triggered[0].frequency).toBeCloseTo(220, 9);
    });

    it('rejects with the reason when the context will not start, and tries again on the next', async () => {
      audio.resumeFails = true;

      await expectAsync(player.audition(cMajor(), 1.5, 120)).toBeRejectedWithError('no user gesture yet');
      expect(audio.synth.triggered).toEqual([]);

      audio.resumeFails = false;
      await player.audition(cMajor(), 1.5, 120);
      expect(audio.resumeCalls).toBe(2);
      expect(audio.synth.triggered.length).toBe(3);
    });

    it('sounds nothing for a tempo or a length it cannot time', async () => {
      await player.audition(cMajor(), 1.5, 0);
      await player.audition(cMajor(), 1.5, NaN);
      await player.audition(cMajor(), 0, 120);
      await player.audition(cMajor(), Infinity, 120);

      expect(audio.synth.triggered).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('sounds nothing once the page has gone, even if it was asked for just before', async () => {
      audio.gateResume = true;
      const heard = player.audition(cMajor(), 1.5, 120);

      TestBed.resetTestingModule();
      audio.openResumeGate();
      await heard;

      expect(audio.synth.triggered).toEqual([]);
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
 * change with the tempo; the song's rhythm is what playing the song is for. The tempo still times each note's own
```

```ts
  }

  /**
   * One chord, heard now: `notes` struck together on this service's chain, each
   * held for its own length at `tempo` but never longer than `seconds`. What the
   * song page plays when a chord is placed or asked for.
   *
   * ## Beside the transport, never on it
   *
   * The notes go straight to the synth at the audio clock's `now()`. Nothing
   * here starts, stops, cancels or re-tempos the transport, and no part is
   * built: the transport is the progression's, and a chord heard in passing has
   * no claim on it. A progression playing under an audition goes on playing,
   * and is still the thing a stop stops.
   *
   * ## A stab, not a replay
   *
   * Every note is struck at the same instant, including one a hand-voiced roll
   * starts partway into its slot: the ear is asking what the chord *is*, and a
   * slot's rhythm is the progression's to play. Each note keeps its own length
   * - converted at `tempo`, as `buildSchedule` converts it - so a short note in a
   * literal slot stays short, and `seconds` caps the rest, so a chord two bars
   * long at 60 BPM does not drone for eight seconds under whatever the user
   * does next. Pitch and level go through the same `frequencyOf` and `gainOf`
   * as playback, so an audition and a play of the same slot sound alike.
   *
   * ## The chord before it is let go
   *
   * Each audition releases what is sounding before it strikes - into the
   * voice's release, not cut off, so there is no click. Clicking through a row
   * of chords is the normal way to use this, and letting each one ring on would
   * stack three or four chords at once into one smear, which is the opposite of
   * hearing the chord just clicked. Not while the transport is running, though:
   * `releaseAll` takes every voice, and the progression's sounding chord is one
   * of them, so over playback an audition sounds on top rather than cutting into
   * the music.
   *
   * ## The gesture, and failing
   *
   * `resume` is called before the first `await`, so it runs inside the click
   * that asked for the chord - the gesture a browser needs before it will start
   * audio. Unlike `play`, a context that will not start is not swallowed here:
   * the promise rejects with the reason, because the page that asked is the one
   * with somewhere to say it. Nothing is remembered about the failure, so the
   * next audition asks again, which is what a later click needs to work once
   * the browser relents.
   *
   * A tempo or length that cannot time a note - zero, `NaN`, infinite - sounds
   * nothing, as `play` refuses a schedule it cannot time; so does an audition
   * that a newer one, or the page going, has overtaken while it waited.
   */
  async audition(notes: readonly RollNote[], seconds: number, tempo: number): Promise<void> {
    const ticket = ++this.auditionTicket;
    const timeable = seconds > 0 && Number.isFinite(seconds) && tempo > 0 && Number.isFinite(tempo);
    if (!timeable || notes.length === 0) return;

    await this.audio.resume();
    if (ticket !== this.auditionTicket) return;

    if (!this.running) this.synth.releaseAll();
    const time = this.audio.now();
    const secondsPerBeat = 60 / tempo;
    for (const note of notes) {
      const duration = Math.min(note.lengthBeats * secondsPerBeat, seconds);
      this.synth.triggerAttackRelease(frequencyOf(note.midi), duration, time, gainOf(note.velocity));
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    // An audition still waiting on the audio context would otherwise strike a
    // synth disposed a few lines down, which Tone answers by throwing.
    this.auditionTicket++;
    this.stop();
    // The transport is global and outlives this service, so a listener left on
```

## Phase G: Open in Progression

A section out to the progression page and its edits back.

### Task G.1: Open a section in the Progression page, and bring its edits back

`ProgressionHandoffService` sends a section's progression to the progression page, keeping the user's own
progression to restore, and a banner there leads back. `adopt` is guarded so the circle cannot re-key the section. On the
way back `songAfterReturnOf` merges three ways - the sent progression, the returned one and the sheet as it stands - into
one undo step with notices for what moved: chords changed and removed, chords added (at the end of the section's last
line), a reorder, a key or tempo not carried back. A section deleted meanwhile offers its chords as a new section.

```ts
import { ComponentFixture, TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { Router, provideRouter } from '@angular/router';
import { BehaviorSubject } from 'rxjs';

import { ProgressionComponent } from './progression.component';
import { createExtensions } from '../../models/progression-normalize';
import { ChordDegree, ProgressionDoc, ProgressionKey } from '../../models/progression.model';
import { MusicTheoryService } from '../../services/music-theory.service';
import {
  PROGRESSION_HANDOFF_STORAGE,
  ProgressionHandoffService,
  SectionHandoff
} from '../../services/progression-handoff.service';
import { ProgressionPlayerService } from '../../services/progression-player.service';
import { ProgressionService } from '../../services/progression.service';
import { chordSlotOf } from '../../services/song-document';

/**
 * The Progression page while a song's section is open on it (Open in Progression, brief decision 7): the banner, the
 * key that holds, and the way back. Beside `progression.component.spec.ts` rather than in it, which is near the
 * thousand-line bound on its own. The page's player is a silent fake, for the reason that file gives.
 */
const C_MAJOR: ProgressionKey = { tonic: 0, scaleId: 'ionian', preferSharps: true };
const IONIAN = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
const FOUR_FOUR = { numerator: 4, denominator: 4, isCommon: true };

function degreeAt(degree: number): ChordDegree {
  return {
    degree,
    alter: 0,
    extent: 3,
    quality: null,
    inversion: 0,
    suspension: 'none',
    extensions: createExtensions(),
    octave: 0
  };
}

/** Verse 1 of "Last Dance", C then Am, as the song page would send it. */
function verse(): SectionHandoff {
  const progression: ProgressionDoc = {
    id: 'v1',
    revision: 0,
    name: 'Last Dance — Verse 1',
    key: C_MAJOR,
    tempo: 100,
    timeSignature: FOUR_FOUR,
    slots: [0, 5].map((degree, index) => ({
      ...chordSlotOf(degreeAt(degree), C_MAJOR, IONIAN, FOUR_FOUR),
      startBeat: index * 4
    }))
  };
  return {
    songId: 'song-1',
    songTitle: 'Last Dance',
    sectionId: 'v1',
    sectionLabel: 'Verse 1',
    sectionKind: 'verse',
    progression
  };
}

describe('ProgressionComponent with a song section open', () => {
  let fixture: ComponentFixture<ProgressionComponent>;
  let progression: ProgressionService;
  let musicTheory: MusicTheoryService;
  let handoff: ProgressionHandoffService;
  let navigate: jasmine.Spy;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    const player = {
      currentSlot$: new BehaviorSubject<string | null>(null),
      isLooping: false,
      update: (): void => undefined,
      stop: (): void => undefined,
      setLoop: (): void => undefined,
      play: (): Promise<void> => Promise.resolve()
    };
    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      imports: [ProgressionComponent],
      providers: [provideRouter([]), { provide: PROGRESSION_HANDOFF_STORAGE, useValue: null }]
    })
      .overrideComponent(ProgressionComponent, {
        set: { providers: [{ provide: ProgressionPlayerService, useValue: player }] }
      })
      .compileComponents();

    progression = TestBed.inject(ProgressionService);
    musicTheory = TestBed.inject(MusicTheoryService);
    handoff = TestBed.inject(ProgressionHandoffService);
    navigate = spyOn(TestBed.inject(Router), 'navigate').and.resolveTo(true);
  });

  afterEach(() => fixture?.destroy());

  function openPage(): void {
    fixture = TestBed.createComponent(ProgressionComponent);
    fixture.detectChanges();
  }

  const page = (): HTMLElement => fixture.nativeElement;
  const banner = (): string =>
    page().querySelector('app-progression-handoff-banner')?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() ?? '';
  const backButton = (): HTMLButtonElement | null =>
    page().querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('app-progression-handoff-banner .handoff-back');

  it("shows no banner over the user's own progression", () => {
    openPage();
    expect(banner()).toBe('');
    expect(backButton()).toBeNull();
  });

  it("names the section and the song over the section's progression, with the way back", () => {
    progression.appendSlot(0);
    handoff.open(verse());
    openPage();

    expect(banner()).toContain('Editing Verse 1 of “Last Dance”');
    expect(backButton()?.textContent?.trim()).toBe('Back to song');
  });

  it("takes the banner away when the user undoes back to their own progression, and brings it back on redo", () => {
    progression.appendSlot(0);
    handoff.open(verse());
    openPage();

    progression.undo();
    fixture.detectChanges();
    expect(banner()).toBe('');

    progression.redo();
    fixture.detectChanges();
    expect(banner()).toContain('Editing Verse 1');
  });

  it("does not re-key the section when the circle turns, and says the song's key holds", () => {
    handoff.open(verse());
    openPage();
    const revision = progression.doc.revision;

    musicTheory.selectKeyAndMode('D', 'diatonicModes', 'ionian');
    fixture.detectChanges();

    expect(progression.doc.key).toEqual(C_MAJOR);
    expect(progression.doc.revision).toBe(revision);
    expect(banner()).toContain("The song's key is C Ionian (Major); it is set on the song.");

    // Back on the song's key, there is nothing to explain.
    musicTheory.selectKeyAndMode('C', 'diatonicModes', 'ionian');
    fixture.detectChanges();
    expect(banner()).not.toContain("The song's key");
  });

  it("does not re-key the section on arrival when the circle is in another key", () => {
    musicTheory.selectKeyAndMode('A', 'diatonicModes', 'aeolian');
    handoff.open(verse());
    openPage();

    expect(progression.doc.key).toEqual(C_MAJOR);
    expect(banner()).toContain("The song's key is C Ionian (Major)");
  });

  it("takes the circle's key again once the section has gone home", async () => {
    handoff.open(verse());
    openPage();
    await handoff.cancel();

    musicTheory.selectKeyAndMode('D', 'diatonicModes', 'ionian');
    expect(progression.doc.key.tonic).toBe(2);
  });

  it("goes back to the song on Back to song, with the user's own progression back on the page", async () => {
    progression.appendSlot(4);
    const own = progression.doc;
    handoff.open(verse());
    openPage();
    navigate.calls.reset();

    backButton()?.click();
    await fixture.whenStable();
    fixture.detectChanges();

    expect(navigate).toHaveBeenCalledOnceWith(['/songs', 'song-1']);
    expect(progression.doc.slots).toEqual(own.slots);
    expect(banner()).toBe('');
  });
});
```

```ts
import { SONG_PREFERENCES_STORAGE } from '../../../services/song-sheet-preferences.service';
import { SONG_AUTOSAVE_CLOCK, SongEditorComponent } from './song-editor.component';

const C_MAJOR: ProgressionKey = { tonic: 0, scaleId: 'ionian', preferSharps: true };
const IONIAN = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
const FOUR_FOUR = { numerator: 4, denominator: 4, isCommon: true };

function degreeAt(degree: number): ChordDegree {
  return {
    degree,
    alter: 0,
    extent: 3,
    quality: null,
    inversion: 0,
    suspension: 'none',
    extensions: createExtensions(),
    octave: 0
  };
}

function chord(degree: number): Node {
  return songSchema.node('chord', chordSlotOf(degreeAt(degree), C_MAJOR, IONIAN, FOUR_FOUR));
}

/** "Last Dance" in C major: one verse, C over "Got" and Am over "thinking". */
function lastDance(): Node {
  return songSchema.node(
    'doc',
    { title: 'Last Dance', artist: 'The Band', key: C_MAJOR, tempo: 100, timeSignature: FOUR_FOUR },
    [
      songSchema.node('section', { id: crypto.randomUUID(), label: 'Verse 1', kind: 'verse' }, [
        songSchema.node('lyricLine', null, [
          chord(0),
          songSchema.text('Got me '),
          chord(5),
          songSchema.text('thinking')
        ])
      ])
    ]
  );
}

/** Time that moves only by hand: these specs save by flushing, never by waiting out autosave's pause. */
class StillClock implements AutosaveClock {
  now(): number {
    return Date.now();
  }

  setTimeout(): unknown {
    return 0;
  }

  clearTimeout(): void {
    // Nothing is ever pending.
  }
}

@Component({ standalone: true, template: '<p class="progression-stand-in">Progression</p>' })
class ProgressionStandIn {}

/**
 * Open in Progression from the song page, and what the page makes of what comes back (brief decision 7): the section
 * menu's item, the save before leaving, and a return applied on load with its notices in the live region. Against real
 * routing, the real hand-off and progression services, and a song library of its own in real IndexedDB; the
 * Progression page is a stand-in, since what happens there is `ProgressionService`'s.
 */
describe('SongEditorComponent and the Progression page', () => {
  let harness: RouterTestingHarness;
  let library: SongLibraryService;
  let handoff: ProgressionHandoffService;
  let progression: ProgressionService;
  let dbName: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    dbName = `song-editor-handoff-spec-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      providers: [
        provideRouter([
          { path: 'songs/:id', component: SongEditorComponent },
          { path: 'progression', component: ProgressionStandIn }
        ]),
        { provide: SONG_LIBRARY_DB, useValue: dbName },
        { provide: SONG_AUTOSAVE_CLOCK, useValue: new StillClock() },
        { provide: SONG_PREFERENCES_STORAGE, useValue: null },
        // A link for this spec only: nothing it opens is left in the tab's session storage.
        { provide: PROGRESSION_HANDOFF_STORAGE, useValue: null }
      ]
    })
      .overrideComponent(SongEditorComponent, {
        set: { providers: [{ provide: ProgressionPlayerService, useValue: { audition: () => Promise.resolve() } }] }
      })
      .compileComponents();
    library = TestBed.inject(SongLibraryService);
    handoff = TestBed.inject(ProgressionHandoffService);
    progression = TestBed.inject(ProgressionService);
    harness = await RouterTestingHarness.create();
  });

  afterEach(async () => {
    harness.fixture.destroy();
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    await deletedDatabase(dbName);
  });

  const host = (): HTMLElement => harness.fixture.nativeElement;
  const text = (selector: string): string =>
    host().querySelector(selector)?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() ?? '';
  const messages = (): string => text('.editor-messages');
  const names = (): string[] =>
    Array.from(host().querySelectorAll('.song-chord-name')).map(name => name.textContent ?? '');

  async function until(done: () => boolean): Promise<void> {
    for (let waited = 0; waited < 2000; waited += 10) {
      harness.detectChanges();
      if (done()) return;
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
    }
    harness.detectChanges();
  }

  async function storeSong(): Promise<SongDoc> {
    const created = await library.createSong();
    return library.saveSong({ ...created, content: lastDance().toJSON() });
  }

  async function open(id: string): Promise<void> {
    await harness.navigateByUrl(`/songs/${id}`, SongEditorComponent);
    await until(() => host().querySelector('.ProseMirror') !== null);
  }

  async function stored(id: string): Promise<Node> {
    const loaded = await library.loadSong(id);
    if (loaded?.kind !== 'song') throw new Error('The song did not load');
    return loaded.node;
  }

  function press(selector: string): void {
    const button = host().querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(selector);
    if (!button) throw new Error(`No ${selector} on the page`);
    button.click();
    harness.detectChanges();
  }

  /** Chooses "Open in Progression" from the first section's ⋮ menu. */
  function openInProgression(): void {
    press('.song-section-menu-toggle');
    const item = Array.from(host().querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('.song-section-menu-item')).find(
      candidate => candidate.textContent?.trim() === 'Open in Progression'
    );
    if (!item) throw new Error('No Open in Progression in the section menu');
    item.click();
  }

  function setTitle(title: string): void {
    const input = host().querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('.song-title');
    if (!input) throw new Error('No title field');
    input.value = title;
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
    harness.detectChanges();
  }

  it('saves the song, then opens the section in the Progression page', async () => {
    const song = await storeSong();
    await open(song.id);
    const verseId = sectionsOf(await stored(song.id))[0].id;
    setTitle('First Dance');
    let titleStoredAtOpen = '';
    const opened = spyOn(handoff, 'open').and.callFake(() => {
      void stored(song.id).then(node => (titleStoredAtOpen = node.attrs['title']));
    });

    openInProgression();
    await until(() => opened.calls.count() > 0 && titleStoredAtOpen !== '');

    expect(opened).toHaveBeenCalledOnceWith(
      jasmine.objectContaining({
        songId: song.id,
        sectionId: verseId,
        sectionLabel: 'Verse 1',
        songTitle: 'First Dance'
      })
    );
    expect(titleStoredAtOpen).toBe('First Dance');
  });

  it('stays, and says why, when the song cannot be saved first', async () => {
    const song = await storeSong();
    await open(song.id);
    setTitle('First Dance');
    spyOn(library, 'saveSong').and.rejectWith(new Error('The disk is full.'));
    const opened = spyOn(handoff, 'open');

    openInProgression();
    await until(() => messages().includes('Not opened in Progression'));

    expect(messages()).toContain('Not opened in Progression: the song could not be saved first. The disk is full.');
    expect(opened).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('applies what comes back as one undo step, and says what changed', async () => {
    const song = await storeSong();
    await open(song.id);
    openInProgression();
    await until(() => text('.progression-stand-in') !== '');

    // On the Progression page: Am becomes Dm and two beats long, and a G goes on the end.
    const am = progression.doc.slots[1].id;
    progression.setSlotChord(am, { degree: 1, alter: 0, quality: null, extent: 3 });
    progression.setSlotLength(am, 2);
    progression.appendSlot(4);
    await handoff.returnToSong();
    await until(() => names().join(' ') === 'C Dm G');

    expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'Dm', 'G']);
    expect(messages()).toContain('Verse 1: 1 chord changed on the Progression page.');
    expect(messages()).toContain(
      "1 chord added on the Progression page is at the end of Verse 1's last line; drag it onto its word."
    );
    const [verse] = sectionsOf(currentDoc());
    expect(sectionProgressionOf(currentDoc(), verse.id)?.slots[1].lengthBeats).toBe(2);

    press('.undo');
    expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'Am']);
  });

  it('offers a new section for chords whose section was deleted while out, and places them on request', async () => {
    const song = await storeSong();
    const doc = await stored(song.id);
    const verse = sectionProgressionOf(doc, sectionsOf(doc)[0].id);
    if (verse === null) throw new Error('No verse');
    const sent = { ...verse, id: 'gone', revision: 3 };
    const back: ProgressionReturn = {
      songId: song.id,
      sectionId: 'gone',
      sectionLabel: 'Bridge',
      sectionKind: 'bridge',
      sent,
      returned: { ...sent, revision: 4 }
    };
    spyOn(handoff, 'takeReturn').and.returnValue([back]);

    await open(song.id);
    await until(() => text('.return-offer') !== '');
    expect(text('.return-offer')).toContain('Bridge is no longer in this song');
    expect(messages()).toContain('Bridge is no longer in this song');

    press('.return-offer .keep-returned');
    await until(() => names().length === 4);

    const sections = sectionsOf(currentDoc());
    expect(sections.map(entry => [entry.label, entry.kind])).toEqual([
      ['Verse 1', 'verse'],
      ['Bridge', 'bridge']
    ]);
    expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'Am', 'C', 'Am']);
    expect(text('.return-offer')).toBe('');
  });

  it('lets the chords whose section was deleted go, when asked to', async () => {
    const song = await storeSong();
    const doc = await stored(song.id);
    const verse = sectionProgressionOf(doc, sectionsOf(doc)[0].id);
    if (verse === null) throw new Error('No verse');
    const sent = { ...verse, id: 'gone', revision: 3 };
    spyOn(handoff, 'takeReturn').and.returnValue([
      {
        songId: song.id,
        sectionId: 'gone',
        sectionLabel: 'Bridge',
        sectionKind: 'bridge',
        sent,
        returned: { ...sent, revision: 4 }
      }
    ]);

    await open(song.id);
    await until(() => text('.return-offer') !== '');
    press('.return-offer .discard-returned');

    expect(text('.return-offer')).toBe('');
    expect(names()).toEqual(['C', 'Am']);
    expect(messages()).toContain('Discarded the chords that came back for Bridge.');
  });

  /** The document the page's sheet holds now. */
  function currentDoc(): Node {
    const page = harness.routeDebugElement?.componentInstance as SongEditorComponent | undefined;
    if (!page?.doc) throw new Error('No song open');
    return page.doc;
  }
});
```

```ts
import { ErrorHandler } from '@angular/core';
import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { Router, provideRouter } from '@angular/router';
import { history } from 'prosemirror-history';
import { Node } from 'prosemirror-model';
import { EditorState } from 'prosemirror-state';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';
import { createExtensions } from '../models/progression-normalize';
import { ChordDegree, ProgressionDoc, ProgressionKey, ProgressionState } from '../models/progression.model';
import { SongMeta } from '../models/song.model';
import {
  HandoffBanner,
  PROGRESSION_HANDOFF_STORAGE,
  ProgressionHandoffService,
  SectionHandoff
} from './progression-handoff.service';
import { ProgressionService } from './progression.service';
import { chordSlotOf, chordsOf, createSongIdsPlugin, sectionsOf } from './song-document';
import { applyReturn, sectionHandoffOf, songAfterReturnOf } from './song-progression-return';
import { songSchema } from './song-schema';

/**
 * Open in Progression and back (brief decision 7): the one link between a song's section and the Progression page,
 * against the real `ProgressionService`. The router is the real one with its `navigate` answered by a spy, and the
 * session storage a link survives a reload in is a map of the spec's own.
 */
const C_MAJOR: ProgressionKey = { tonic: 0, scaleId: 'ionian', preferSharps: true };
const IONIAN = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
const FOUR_FOUR = { numerator: 4, denominator: 4, isCommon: true };
const META: SongMeta = { title: 'Last Dance', artist: 'The Band', key: C_MAJOR, tempo: 100, timeSignature: FOUR_FOUR };

function degreeAt(degree: number): ChordDegree {
  return {
    degree,
    alter: 0,
    extent: 3,
    quality: null,
    inversion: 0,
    suspension: 'none',
    extensions: createExtensions(),
    octave: 0
  };
}

function chord(degree: number, id: string): Node {
  return songSchema.node('chord', { ...chordSlotOf(degreeAt(degree), C_MAJOR, IONIAN, FOUR_FOUR), id });
}

/** "Last Dance": Verse 1 is C and Am, the chorus G. */
function lastDance(): Node {
  return songSchema.node('doc', META, [
    songSchema.node('section', { id: 'v1', label: 'Verse 1', kind: 'verse' }, [
      songSchema.node('lyricLine', null, [
        chord(0, 'C'),
        songSchema.text('Got me '),
        chord(5, 'Am'),
        songSchema.text('thinking')
      ])
    ]),
    songSchema.node('section', { id: 'c1', label: 'Chorus', kind: 'chorus' }, [
      songSchema.node('lyricLine', null, [chord(4, 'G'), songSchema.text('Oh')])
    ])
  ]);
}

function handoffOf(doc: Node, sectionId: string, songId = 'song-1'): SectionHandoff {
  const section = sectionHandoffOf(songId, doc, sectionId);
  if (section === null) throw new Error(`No section ${sectionId}`);
  return section;
}

/** Session storage for one spec: what a link is kept in across a reload. */
class MemoryStorage implements Storage {
  private readonly items = new Map<string, string>();

  get length(): number {
    return this.items.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.items.clear();
  }

  getItem(key: string): string | null {
    return this.items.get(key) ?? null;
  }

  key(index: number): string | null {
    return [...this.items.keys()][index] ?? null;
  }

  removeItem(key: string): void {
    this.items.delete(key);
  }

  setItem(key: string, value: string): void {
    this.items.set(key, value);
  }
}

describe('ProgressionHandoffService', () => {
  let storage: MemoryStorage;
  let handoff: ProgressionHandoffService;
  let progression: ProgressionService;
  let navigate: jasmine.Spy;
  let errors: jasmine.Spy;

  /** A fresh app on `storage`: what a reload of the page is, as far as these services can tell. */
  function startApp(): void {
    TestBed.resetTestingModule();
    TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      providers: [
        provideRouter([]),
        { provide: PROGRESSION_HANDOFF_STORAGE, useValue: storage },
        { provide: ErrorHandler, useValue: { handleError: jasmine.createSpy('handleError') } }
      ]
    });
    progression = TestBed.inject(ProgressionService);
    handoff = TestBed.inject(ProgressionHandoffService);
    navigate = spyOn(TestBed.inject(Router), 'navigate').and.resolveTo(true);
    errors = TestBed.inject(ErrorHandler).handleError as jasmine.Spy;
  }

  /** The user's own progression: two chords, unsaved, as they would be after a few clicks on the palette. */
  function ownProgression(): ProgressionDoc {
    progression.appendSlot(0);
    progression.appendSlot(4);
    return progression.doc;
  }

  function currentState(): Promise<ProgressionState> {
    return firstValueFrom(progression.getState());
  }

  beforeEach(() => {
    storage = new MemoryStorage();
    startApp();
  });

  describe('going out', () => {
    it("puts the section's progression on the page, keeps the user's own, records the revision and goes there", () => {
      const own = ownProgression();
      handoff.open(handoffOf(lastDance(), 'v1'));

      expect(progression.doc.id).toBe('v1');
      expect(progression.doc.slots.map(slot => slot.id)).toEqual(['C', 'Am']);
      expect(handoff.link?.previous).toEqual(own);
      expect(handoff.link?.sent.revision).toBe(progression.doc.revision);
      expect(handoff.link).toEqual(
        jasmine.objectContaining({
          songId: 'song-1',
          sectionId: 'v1',
          sectionLabel: 'Verse 1',
          songTitle: 'Last Dance'
        })
      );
      expect(handoff.isLinked(progression.doc)).toBeTrue();
      expect(navigate).toHaveBeenCalledOnceWith(['/progression']);
    });

    it('opens the section clean, so nothing reads as an unsaved change of its own', async () => {
      ownProgression();
      handoff.open(handoffOf(lastDance(), 'v1'));
      expect((await currentState()).isDirty).toBeFalse();
    });

    it("keeps the user's own progression through a second open, of another section or another song", () => {
      const own = ownProgression();
      handoff.open(handoffOf(lastDance(), 'v1'));
      handoff.open(handoffOf(lastDance(), 'c1', 'song-2'));

      expect(progression.doc.id).toBe('c1');
      expect(handoff.link?.previous).toEqual(own);
      expect(handoff.link?.songId).toBe('song-2');
    });

    it("keeps the first section's edits for its song when a second is opened over them", () => {
      ownProgression();
      handoff.open(handoffOf(lastDance(), 'v1'));
      progression.setSlotLength('Am', 8);
      handoff.open(handoffOf(lastDance(), 'c1', 'song-2'));

      const [kept] = handoff.takeReturn('song-1');
      expect(kept.sectionId).toBe('v1');
      expect(kept.returned.slots[1].lengthBeats).toBe(8);
      expect(handoff.takeReturn('song-2')).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('carries on with the section already open there, edits and all, rather than deriving it again over them', () => {
      ownProgression();
      handoff.open(handoffOf(lastDance(), 'v1'));
      progression.setSlotLength('Am', 8);
      const edited = progression.doc;
      handoff.open(handoffOf(lastDance(), 'v1'));

      expect(progression.doc).toBe(edited);
      expect(navigate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);

  describe('coming back', () => {

      const song = lastDance();
      handoff.open(handoffOf(song, 'v1'));
      progression.setSlotLength('Am', 2);
      progression.setSlotChord('Am', { degree: 5, alter: 0, quality: 'minor7', extent: 7 });
      const changed = progression.doc.slots[1];
      await handoff.returnToSong();

      const [back] = handoff.takeReturn('song-1');
      const state = EditorState.create({ doc: song, plugins: [history(), createSongIdsPlugin()] });
      const outcome = songAfterReturnOf(state.doc, back.sectionId, back.returned, back.sent);
      if (outcome.kind !== 'changes') throw new Error(`Expected changes, got ${outcome.kind}`);
      const run = applyReturn(state.doc, outcome.steps)(state);
      if (run.kind !== 'edit') throw new Error('The return did not apply');
      const after = state.apply(run.tr).doc;

      const [verse] = sectionsOf(after);
      const am = chordsOf(verse.node, verse.pos).find(entry => entry.attrs.id === 'Am')?.attrs;
      expect(am?.lengthBeats).toBe(2);
      expect(am?.harmony).toEqual(changed.harmony);
      expect(am?.notes).toEqual(changed.notes);
      expect(am?.harmony.kind === 'degree' && am.harmony.degree.quality).toBe('minor7');
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
import { history, undo, undoDepth } from 'prosemirror-history';
import { Node } from 'prosemirror-model';
import { EditorState } from 'prosemirror-state';
import { createExtensions } from '../models/progression-normalize';
import { ChordDegree, ChordSlot, ProgressionDoc, ProgressionKey } from '../models/progression.model';
import { ChordAtomAttrs, SongMeta } from '../models/song.model';
import { regenerateSlot } from './progression-edit';
import { SongEdit } from './song-commands';
import {
  chordSlotOf,
  chordsOf,
  createSongIdsPlugin,
  sectionProgressionOf,
  sectionsOf,
  songMetaOf
} from './song-document';
import {
  SongAfterReturn,
  addReturnedSection,
  applyReturn,
  sectionHandoffOf,
  songAfterReturnOf
} from './song-progression-return';
import { songSchema } from './song-schema';

/**
 * Bringing a section's progression back from the Progression page into the song (brief decision 7), on a headless
 * `EditorState` carrying the history and id plugins the sheet runs with, so "one undo step" is asked of the real
 * history.
 */
const C_MAJOR: ProgressionKey = { tonic: 0, scaleId: 'ionian', preferSharps: true };
const IONIAN = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
const FOUR_FOUR = { numerator: 4, denominator: 4, isCommon: true };
const META: SongMeta = { title: 'Last Dance', artist: 'The Band', key: C_MAJOR, tempo: 100, timeSignature: FOUR_FOUR };

function degreeAt(degree: number): ChordDegree {
  return {
    degree,
    alter: 0,
    extent: 3,
    quality: null,
    inversion: 0,
    suspension: 'none',
    extensions: createExtensions(),
    octave: 0
  };
}

function attrsOn(degree: number, id: string): ChordAtomAttrs {
  return { ...chordSlotOf(degreeAt(degree), C_MAJOR, IONIAN, FOUR_FOUR), id };
}

function chord(degree: number, id: string): Node {
  return songSchema.node('chord', attrsOn(degree, id));
}

function line(...content: (string | Node)[]): Node {
  return songSchema.node(
    'lyricLine',
    null,
    content.map(part => (typeof part === 'string' ? songSchema.text(part) : part))
  );
}

/**
 * "Last Dance": Verse 1 is C over "Got", Am over "thinking", then F over "of you" on a second line; the chorus is G.
 * Chord ids are their names, so a spec can say which chord it means.
 */
function lastDance(): Node {
  return songSchema.node('doc', META, [
    songSchema.node('section', { id: 'v1', label: 'Verse 1', kind: 'verse' }, [
      line(chord(0, 'C'), 'Got me ', chord(5, 'Am'), 'thinking'),
      line(chord(3, 'F'), 'of you')
    ]),
    songSchema.node('section', { id: 'c1', label: 'Chorus', kind: 'chorus' }, [line(chord(4, 'G'), 'Oh')])
  ]);
}

function stateOf(doc: Node): EditorState {
  return EditorState.create({ doc, plugins: [history(), createSongIdsPlugin()] });
}

/** Verse 1's progression as the store would have published it on the way out: revision 5. */
function sentOf(doc: Node): ProgressionDoc {
  const derived = sectionProgressionOf(doc, 'v1');
  if (derived === null) throw new Error('No Verse 1');
  return { ...derived, revision: 5 };
}

/** `sent` as the Progression page hands it back: a later revision, with `edit` applied to its slots. */
function returnedOf(
  sent: ProgressionDoc,
  edit: (slots: ChordSlot[]) => ChordSlot[],
  extra: Partial<ProgressionDoc> = {}
): ProgressionDoc {
  return { ...structuredClone(sent), revision: 9, slots: edit(structuredClone(sent.slots)), ...extra };
}

function slot(slots: readonly ChordSlot[], id: string): ChordSlot {
  const found = slots.find(candidate => candidate.id === id);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`No slot ${id}`);
  return found;
}

/** `slots` with the chord `id` made `beats` long. */
function lengthened(slots: ChordSlot[], id: string, beats: number): ChordSlot[] {
  return slots.map(each => (each.id === id ? { ...each, lengthBeats: beats } : each));
}

/** `slot` made the chord on `degree`, voiced in C major. */
function rechorded(original: ChordSlot, degree: number): ChordSlot {
  return regenerateSlot({ ...original, harmony: { kind: 'degree', degree: degreeAt(degree) } }, C_MAJOR, IONIAN);
}

/** A new slot, as the Progression page's palette would add one. */
function added(degree: number, id: string): ChordSlot {
  return { ...attrsOn(degree, id), startBeat: 0 };
}

/** Each lyric line of the section `id`, its words with each chord written as `[id]` where it sits. */
function linesOf(doc: Node, id: string): string[] {
  const section = sectionsOf(doc).find(entry => entry.id === id);
  if (!section) throw new Error(`No section ${id}`);
  const lines: string[] = [];
  section.node.forEach(child => {
    if (child.type.name !== 'lyricLine') return;
    let text = '';
    child.forEach(part => (text += part.isText ? part.text : `[${part.attrs['id']}]`));
    lines.push(text);
  });
  return lines;
}

function atom(doc: Node, id: string): ChordAtomAttrs {
  for (const section of sectionsOf(doc)) {
    const found = chordsOf(section.node, section.pos).find(entry => entry.attrs.id === id);
    if (found) return found.attrs;
  }
  throw new Error(`No chord ${id}`);
}

/** Runs `edit` on `state`, expecting it to change the song, and returns the new state. */
function ran(state: EditorState, edit: SongEdit): EditorState {
  const outcome = edit(state);
  if (outcome.kind !== 'edit') throw new Error(`The edit did not run: ${JSON.stringify(outcome)}`);
  return state.apply(outcome.tr);
}

/** The outcome's changes applied, as the page applies them: one `applyReturn` on the state they were made from. */
function applied(state: EditorState, outcome: SongAfterReturn): EditorState {
  if (outcome.kind !== 'changes') throw new Error(`Expected changes, got ${outcome.kind}`);
  return ran(state, applyReturn(state.doc, outcome.steps));
}

function noticesOf(outcome: SongAfterReturn): readonly string[] {
  return outcome.kind === 'changes' ? outcome.notices : [];
}

describe('songAfterReturnOf', () => {
  let state: EditorState;
  let sent: ProgressionDoc;

  beforeEach(() => {
    state = stateOf(lastDance());
    sent = sentOf(state.doc);
  });

  it('applies nothing when the revision did not move', () => {
    const returned = returnedOf(sent, slots => slots.map(each => ({ ...each, lengthBeats: 8 })), { revision: 5 });
    expect(songAfterReturnOf(state.doc, 'v1', returned, sent)).toEqual({ kind: 'unchanged' });
  });

  it('applies nothing when the revision moved but every chord came back as it went', () => {
    expect(songAfterReturnOf(state.doc, 'v1', returnedOf(sent, slots => slots), sent)).toEqual({ kind: 'unchanged' });
  });

  it('writes a chord changed there over its atom, by id, and leaves the others and the words alone', () => {
    const returned = returnedOf(sent, slots =>
      slots.map(each => (each.id === 'Am' ? { ...rechorded(each, 1), lengthBeats: 8 } : each))
    );
    const outcome = songAfterReturnOf(state.doc, 'v1', returned, sent);
    const after = applied(state, outcome).doc;

    const am = atom(after, 'Am');
    expect(am.lengthBeats).toBe(8);
    expect(am.harmony).toEqual(slot(returned.slots, 'Am').harmony);
    expect(am.notes).toEqual(slot(returned.slots, 'Am').notes);
    expect(atom(after, 'C')).toEqual(atom(state.doc, 'C'));
    expect(atom(after, 'F')).toEqual(atom(state.doc, 'F'));
    expect(linesOf(after, 'v1')).toEqual(['[C]Got me [Am]thinking', '[F]of you']);
    expect(noticesOf(outcome)).toEqual(['Verse 1: 1 chord changed on the Progression page.']);
  });

  it('keeps an edit made on the sheet since the section was sent, where the chord came back untouched', () => {
    // Am became Dm on the sheet after the section went out; the Progression page changed only F.
    const edited = state.apply(
      state.tr.setNodeAttribute(chordAt(state.doc, 'Am'), 'harmony', { kind: 'degree', degree: degreeAt(1) })
    );
    const returned = returnedOf(sent, slots => lengthened(slots, 'F', 2));
    const after = applied(edited, songAfterReturnOf(edited.doc, 'v1', returned, sent)).doc;

    expect(atom(after, 'Am').harmony).toEqual({ kind: 'degree', degree: degreeAt(1) });
    expect(atom(after, 'F').lengthBeats).toBe(2);
  });

  it('keeps a chord placed on the sheet since the section was sent', () => {
    const late = state.apply(state.tr.insert(chordAt(state.doc, 'F'), chord(4, 'late')));
    const returned = returnedOf(sent, slots => lengthened(slots, 'C', 2));
    const after = applied(late, songAfterReturnOf(late.doc, 'v1', returned, sent)).doc;

    expect(linesOf(after, 'v1')).toEqual(['[C]Got me [Am]thinking', '[late][F]of you']);
  });

  it('deletes the atom of a chord removed there, and keeps its words', () => {
    const returned = returnedOf(sent, slots => slots.filter(each => each.id !== 'Am'));
    const outcome = songAfterReturnOf(state.doc, 'v1', returned, sent);
    const after = applied(state, outcome).doc;

    expect(linesOf(after, 'v1')).toEqual(['[C]Got me thinking', '[F]of you']);
    expect(noticesOf(outcome)).toEqual(['Verse 1: 1 chord removed on the Progression page.']);
  });

  it("appends chords added there at the end of the section's last line, in their order, and says how many", () => {
    const returned = returnedOf(sent, slots => [...slots, added(4, 'G7'), added(0, 'Cend')]);
    const outcome = songAfterReturnOf(state.doc, 'v1', returned, sent);
    const after = applied(state, outcome).doc;

    expect(linesOf(after, 'v1')).toEqual(['[C]Got me [Am]thinking', '[F]of you[G7][Cend]']);
    expect(linesOf(after, 'c1')).toEqual(['[G]Oh']);
    expect(atom(after, 'G7').harmony).toEqual(added(4, 'G7').harmony);
    expect(noticesOf(outcome)).toEqual([
      "2 chords added on the Progression page are at the end of Verse 1's last line; drag each onto its word."
    ]);
  });

  it('gives a section with no line of lyrics one, to hold the chords added there', () => {
    const doc = songSchema.node('doc', META, [
      songSchema.node('section', { id: 'v1', label: 'Verse 1', kind: 'verse' }, [
        songSchema.node('memo', { id: 'm1', name: 'Hum', durationSec: 3 })
      ])
    ]);
    const memoState = stateOf(doc);
    const memoSent = sentOf(doc);
    const returned = returnedOf(memoSent, () => [added(0, 'C')]);
    const after = applied(memoState, songAfterReturnOf(doc, 'v1', returned, memoSent)).doc;

    expect(linesOf(after, 'v1')).toEqual(['[C]']);

  it("keeps the lyrics' order when the chords were reordered there, and says so", () => {

    const outcome = songAfterReturnOf(state.doc, 'v1', returned, sent);

    expect(outcome.kind).toBe('changes');
    if (outcome.kind !== 'changes') return;
    expect(outcome.steps).toEqual([]);
    expect(outcome.notices).toEqual([
      'The chords were reordered on the Progression page; on the sheet each keeps its place in the words.'

  it('does not carry back a key or a tempo changed there, and says which', () => {
    const returned = returnedOf(sent, slots => slots, {
      key: { tonic: 2, scaleId: 'ionian', preferSharps: true },

    const outcome = songAfterReturnOf(state.doc, 'v1', returned, sent);

    const removed = state.apply(state.tr.delete(chordAt(state.doc, 'Am'), chordAt(state.doc, 'Am') + 1));
    const returned = returnedOf(sent, slots => lengthened(slots, 'Am', 8));

    expect(noticesOf(outcome)).toEqual([

    const returned = returnedOf(sent, slots => [...slots, added(4, 'G7')]);
    const outcome = songAfterReturnOf(gone.doc, 'v1', returned, sent);

    expect(outcome.kind).toBe('sectionGone');

    const returned = returnedOf(sent, slots => [...slots.slice(1), added(4, 'G7')]);
    const before = JSON.stringify([state.doc.toJSON(), returned, sent]);
    songAfterReturnOf(state.doc, 'v1', returned, sent);
    expect(JSON.stringify([state.doc.toJSON(), returned, sent])).toBe(before);
  });
});

describe('applyReturn', () => {
  it('refuses steps made from another document', () => {
    const state = stateOf(lastDance());
    const sent = sentOf(state.doc);
    const outcome = songAfterReturnOf(state.doc, 'v1', returnedOf(sent, slots => slots.slice(1)), sent);
    if (outcome.kind !== 'changes') throw new Error('Expected changes');
    const moved = state.apply(state.tr.insertText('Hey ', 2));

    expect(applyReturn(state.doc, outcome.steps)(moved)).toEqual({
      kind: 'refused',
      reason: "The song changed before the Progression page's chords could be brought back."
    });
  });
});

describe('addReturnedSection', () => {
  it('puts the chords in a new section at the end of the song, as copies with ids of their own, as one step', () => {
    const state = stateOf(lastDance());
    const chords = [attrsOn(0, 'x1'), attrsOn(4, 'x2')];
    const after = ran(state, addReturnedSection('Verse 1', 'verse', chords));

    const sections = sectionsOf(after.doc);
    expect(sections.map(entry => [entry.label, entry.kind])).toEqual([
      ['Verse 1', 'verse'],
      ['Chorus', 'chorus'],
      ['Verse 1', 'verse']
    ]);
    const placed = chordsOf(sections[2].node, sections[2].pos).map(entry => entry.attrs);
    expect(placed.map(entry => entry.harmony)).toEqual(chords.map(entry => entry.harmony));
    expect(placed.map(entry => entry.id)).not.toContain('x1');
    expect(undoDepth(after)).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe('sectionHandoffOf', () => {
  it("is the section's derived progression, with what the Progression page says about it", () => {
    const doc = lastDance();
    expect(sectionHandoffOf('song-1', doc, 'c1')).toEqual({
      songId: 'song-1',
      songTitle: 'Last Dance',
      sectionId: 'c1',
      sectionLabel: 'Chorus',
      sectionKind: 'chorus',
      progression: jasmine.objectContaining({ id: 'c1', slots: [jasmine.objectContaining({ id: 'G' })] })
    });
    expect(songMetaOf(doc).title).toBe('Last Dance');
  });

  it('calls an untitled song what the rest of the app calls it', () => {
    const doc = songSchema.node('doc', { ...META, title: '  ' }, [lastDance().child(0)]);
    expect(sectionHandoffOf('song-1', doc, 'v1')?.songTitle).toBe('Untitled song');
  });

  it('is null for a section the song does not have', () => {
    expect(sectionHandoffOf('song-1', lastDance(), 'nope')).toBeNull();
  });
});

/** The position of the chord atom `id`. */
function chordAt(doc: Node, id: string): number {
  for (const section of sectionsOf(doc)) {
    const found = chordsOf(section.node, section.pos).find(entry => entry.attrs.id === id);
    if (found) return found.pos;
  }
  throw new Error(`No chord ${id}`);
}
```

```scss
// The page's tokens (`--page-*`, declared on the Progression page's host) are read with their values as fallbacks, so
// the banner renders as it will on the page even without one around it. Its own two: the accent is the composer's
// "this one" blue, marking the progression as one that belongs somewhere else, and the link is a lighter blue than the
// focus ring, measuring 4.8:1 on the raised surface where the focus blue measures 3.8:1.
:host {
  --handoff-accent: #3498db;
  --handoff-link: #85c1e9;

  display: block;
}

// No banner, no box: the rail's 1px gaps would otherwise draw an empty line above the Key block.
:host(:empty) {
  display: none;
}

.handoff {
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--handoff-accent, #3498db);
  background: var(--page-rail-raised, #34495e);
  color: var(--page-text, #ecf0f1);
}

.handoff-text {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.handoff-dot {
  margin: 0 0.15rem;
  color: var(--page-text-dim, #adbcc8);
}

// A link-like button, flat as the user's tools are: the banner's one action, not a second accent.
.handoff-back {
  padding: 0.1rem 0.3rem;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--handoff-link, #85c1e9);
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: underline;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 90ms ease-out;

  &:hover {
    background: rgb(255 255 255 / 10%);
  }

  &:active {
    background: rgb(255 255 255 / 16%);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--page-focus, #5dade2);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}

.handoff-key {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--page-text-dim, #adbcc8);

  &.is-quiet {
    margin: 0;
  }
}

// Where the rail becomes a row of blocks (the page's own breakpoint), the banner takes the whole row above them.
@media (max-width: 46rem) {
  :host {
    flex: 1 1 100%;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { NgIf } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, ChangeDetectorRef, Component, OnDestroy, OnInit, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { Subject, takeUntil } from 'rxjs';
import { MusicTheoryService } from '../../../../services/music-theory.service';
import { HandoffBanner, ProgressionHandoffService } from '../../../../services/progression-handoff.service';

/** What the banner shows: the link's names, and the key note in words - empty when there is nothing to explain. */
interface BannerView {
  sectionLabel: string;
  songTitle: string;
  keyNote: string;
}

/**
 * The Progression page's banner while a song's section is open there (Open in Progression, brief decision 7):
 * "Editing Verse 1 of "Last Dance" · Back to song".
 *
 * **At the top of the rail**, above the Key block, rather than across the page: the rail is where the page says what
 * it is working on and in what key, and the one thing the banner has to explain besides the way back - that the key
 * is the song's - belongs directly over the block that names the key and points at the circle of fifths. A strip
 * across the working area would push the palette, the roll and the strip down for a reminder.
 *
 * **The key note** appears while the circle names a key other than the song's - turned while the section is open,
 * or already elsewhere when it arrived - since the rail's Key block below still says the circle sets the key, and
 * here it does not: the song's key holds, and it is set on the song. It is a status region, always in the banner and
 * only its words changing, so turning the circle is announced.
 *
 * A component of its own rather than more of `ProgressionComponent`, which is past the thousand-line bound already:
 * the page only places it and declines the circle's key (`adopt`).
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-progression-handoff-banner',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [NgIf],
  templateUrl: './progression-handoff-banner.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./progression-handoff-banner.component.scss'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class ProgressionHandoffBannerComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  private readonly handoff = inject(ProgressionHandoffService);
  private readonly musicTheory = inject(MusicTheoryService);
  private readonly changes = inject(ChangeDetectorRef);
  private readonly destroy$ = new Subject<void>();

  /** The banner, or null while no song's section is the progression open. */
  view: BannerView | null = null;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.handoff.banner$.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$)).subscribe(banner => {
      this.view = banner === null ? null : this.viewOf(banner);
      this.changes.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  /** Back to song: the section's edits go home with it, and the user's own progression comes back here. */
  back(): void {
    void this.handoff.returnToSong();
  }

  private viewOf(banner: HandoffBanner): BannerView {
    const tonic = this.musicTheory.spellNote(banner.key.tonic, banner.key.preferSharps);
    // Named as the rail's Key block names it (`ProgressionComponent.render`), so the two read as one key.
    const key = banner.scaleName === null ? tonic : `${tonic} ${banner.scaleName}`;
    return {
      sectionLabel: banner.sectionLabel,
      songTitle: banner.songTitle,
      keyNote: banner.keyHeld ? `The song's key is ${key}; it is set on the song.` : ''
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Open in Progression
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * A section's ⋮ → Open in Progression: saves the song, then sends the section to the Progression page. A song that
   * cannot be saved stays open here, with the reason in the live region (see the class comment). Read after the save,
   * so whatever was typed while it ran goes too; leaving the page saves that as well.
   */
  async openInProgression(sectionId: string): Promise<void> {
    const autosave = this.autosave;
    const songId = this.songId;
    if (autosave === null || songId === null) return;

    this.commitFields();
    const status = await autosave.flush();
    // Another song opened in the page while it saved, or the page went: this section is no longer the one asked for.
    if (this.autosave !== autosave) return;
    if (status.kind === 'failed') {
      this.say(`Not opened in Progression: the song could not be saved first. ${status.reason}`, true);
      return;
    }

    const doc = this.sheet?.editorState()?.doc ?? null;
    const section = doc === null ? null : sectionHandoffOf(songId, doc, sectionId);
    if (section === null) {
      this.say('That section is no longer in the song.', true);
      return;
    }
    this.handoff.open(section);
  }

  /** "Put them in a new section": the offer's chords, in a section of their own at the end of the song. */
  keepReturnedChords(offer: ReturnOffer): void {
    if (this.sheet?.run(addReturnedSection(offer.label, offer.kind, offer.chords))) {
      this.dropOffer(offer);
      this.say(`Put the chords that came back for ${offer.label} in a new section at the end of the song.`);
      this.focusSheet();
    }
  }

  /** "Discard them": the offer's chords go, on the user's word. */
  discardReturnedChords(offer: ReturnOffer): void {
    this.dropOffer(offer);
    this.say(`Discarded the chords that came back for ${offer.label}.`);
  }
```

```ts
    } else {
      this.startAutosave(opened.record);
      this.songId = opened.record.id;
      this.initialDoc = opened.node;
      this.adopt(opened.node);
      this.phase = 'ready';
      // The sheet is made now rather than on the next frame, so what came back from the Progression page goes in

  /**
   * Applies what the Progression page handed back for the song `songId`, each return as one undo step through the
   * sheet, and says in the live region what that did. A return whose section has gone becomes an offer.
   */
  private applyReturns(songId: string): void {
    const sheet = this.sheet;
    if (sheet === undefined) return;
    const said: string[] = [];
    let failed = false;
    for (const back of this.handoff.takeReturn(songId)) {
      const state = sheet.editorState();
      if (state === null) break;
      const outcome = songAfterReturnOf(state.doc, back.sectionId, back.returned, back.sent);
      if (outcome.kind === 'refused') {
        said.push(outcome.reason);
        failed = true;
      } else if (outcome.kind === 'sectionGone') {
        said.push(this.offerReturned(back, outcome.chords));
      } else if (outcome.kind === 'changes') {
        // A refusal to apply is said by the sheet, on `refused`.
        const applied = outcome.steps.length === 0 || sheet.run(applyReturn(state.doc, outcome.steps));
        if (applied) said.push(...outcome.notices);
      }
    }
    if (said.length > 0) this.say(said.join(' '), failed);
  }

  /** Puts the chords of `back`, whose section has gone, on offer, and returns what to say about it. */
  private offerReturned(back: ProgressionReturn, chords: readonly ChordAtomAttrs[]): string {
    const label = back.sectionLabel;
    if (chords.length === 0) {
      return `${label} is no longer in this song, and it came back from the Progression page with no chords.`;
    }
    const count = `${chords.length} chord${chords.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
    const text = `${label} is no longer in this song. ${count} came back for it from the Progression page.`;
    this.returnOffers = [...this.returnOffers, { label, kind: back.sectionKind, chords, text }];
    return `${text} Put them in a new section, or discard them.`;
  }

  private dropOffer(offer: ReturnOffer): void {
    this.returnOffers = this.returnOffers.filter(each => each !== offer);
    this.changes.markForCheck();
  }
```
